guide.summary: 不 and 没 both mean 'not', but they answer different questions. 不 denies that something is so or will be so: habits, plans, willingness, qualities, states and modal verbs. 没(有) denies that something happened or has happened up to a point in time, and it is the only negative for 有. Ask yourself: 'isn't / won't / doesn't' (不) or 'didn't / hasn't' (没)?

subs.label: 不 for habits, the future and refusing
subs.focus: Force 不 with a habit or future signal (平时, 每天, 明天, 以后) or a refusal. Learner must resist 没 for doesn't / won't. Errors: 我明天没去, 他平时没喝酒. Include past habits (小时候, 以前 + 不), where a past time word tempts 没.

subs.label: 不 with adjectives, 是, 在, 知道, 认识
subs.focus: Adjectives and state verbs (是, 在 + place, 知道, 认识, 喜欢, 觉得) take 不 even with 昨天 or 以前. Errors: 昨天没冷, 我以前没知道, 他没是老师. Do not mark 没在 + place or 还没 + adjective (天还没黑) as wrong; both are accepted.

subs.label: 不 before modal verbs
subs.focus: Modals take 不, also for the past, and 不 goes before the modal, not the main verb. Errors: 我没会开车, 我昨天没想去, 我会不说汉语. Test with 会, 可以, 应该, 愿意, 想 (want to). Never treat 没能, 没想到 or 还没会 as wrong.

subs.label: 没 for didn't, haven't yet, 过 and 在
subs.focus: An action verb that did not happen, has not happened yet (还没...呢), was never experienced (没 + verb + 过) or is not in progress (没在 + verb) takes 没. Time word, 还 or 过 must force it. Errors: 我昨天不去, 我还不吃饭, 我不去过中国.

subs.label: 有 is negated only with 没
subs.focus: Possession and existence 有 always becomes 没有 (or 没 before a noun), in past, present and future. The learner must reject 不有 everywhere, including with 明天 or in A-not-A questions (有没有, never 有不有). Classic error: 我不有时间, 明天我不有课.

subs.label: 没 replaces 了
subs.focus: Negating a completed action: 没 goes in, 了 comes out, 过 stays. Learner decides whether 了 belongs (cloze with ∅, judge, rewrite 'Make it negative.'). Errors: 我昨天没去了, 他没买了那本书. Never use 好久没...了 or 没有 + noun + 了 as wrong: both are correct.

subs.label: Same verb, different meaning
subs.focus: Same verb takes both; meaning differs: 不 = isn't going to / refuses / doesn't as a rule, 没 = didn't / hasn't. The English cue or a context clause must force one (他不来 vs 他没来; 我不吃肉 vs 我没吃). Error: picking by habit instead of by the tense and intent of the cue.

subs.label: 没 + result complement, verb + 不 + complement
subs.focus: Result not reached = 没 + verb + result (没听懂, 没找到); cannot = verb + 不 + result (听不懂, 找不到). Learner chooses the word and its position. Errors: 我不听懂 for 'didn't understand', 我不能听懂 for 'can't understand'. Avoid 'if not' sentences (不做完不能走), where 不 + verb + result is right.

subs.label: 别 / 不要 / 不用 for commands
subs.focus: 'Don't!' = 别 / 不要 + verb; 不用 = no need to. The cue must separate prohibition from no need. Errors: 不说话! or 你没去! as a command, 不用 used for 'don't'. Never set 别 against 不要 as options: both are right. 别...了 = stop doing.

rules.rule: Use 不 for what someone doesn't do as a habit, isn't going to do, or refuses to do. A past habit (以前, 小时候) also takes 不.

rules.rule: Adjectives and state verbs (是, 在 + place, 知道, 认识, 喜欢, 觉得) are negated with 不, whatever the time.

rules.note: 不是 has no exception. For location, 不在 is the standard form, but 没在家 is also heard, especially about the past. 还没 + adjective is correct when a change has not happened yet: 天还没黑, 饭还没好.

rules.rule: Put 不 before the modal verb (会, 能, 可以, 应该, 想, 要, 愿意), not before the main verb, and keep 不 even for the past.

rules.note: 可以, 应该 and 愿意 never take 没, and 会 only in 还没(学)会 ('haven't learned to yet'). 没能 + verb ('didn't manage to') and 没想到 ('didn't expect') do exist, so they are not errors.

rules.rule: Use 没(有) when an action did not happen or has not happened yet. 还没 means 'not yet', 没 + verb + 过 means 'have never', 没在 + verb means 'wasn't / isn't doing'.
rules.pattern: Subject + (还) + 没(有) + Verb + (过) + Object

rules.note: 没 and 没有 are interchangeable before a verb. At the end of a sentence or as a one-word answer only 没有 is used: 你吃了吗？还没有。 For 'not doing it right now', 不在 + verb is also said (他不在看电视); 没在 is the safer form.

rules.rule: 有 is never negated with 不. 'Don't have' and 'there isn't' are always 没有, for any time; the question form is 有没有.

rules.note: Before a noun 没有 can shorten to 没 in speech: 我没钱, 我没时间.

rules.rule: To negate a completed action, swap 了 for 没: the negative sentence has no 了. 过 is different and stays.
rules.pattern: Verb + 了 + Object -> 没 + Verb + Object

rules.note: Two correct patterns do combine 没 with a final 了: a length of time since something last happened (我们好久没见面了) and 'no longer have' (我没有钱了). Neither negates a completed action.

rules.rule: With the same action verb, 不 says the action is not chosen or not a habit (won't, doesn't, isn't going to); 没 says it did not take place (didn't, hasn't).
rules.pattern: 不 + Verb = won't / doesn't; 没 + Verb = didn't / hasn't

rules.note: 不 about a past moment means a refusal at that time: 昨天我请他，他不来 ('he wouldn't come'), while 他没来 only reports that he did not come.

rules.rule: A result that was not achieved: 没 before the verb + result. A result that cannot be achieved: 不 between the verb and the result.
rules.pattern: 没 + Verb + Result (didn't) / Verb + 不 + Result (can't)

rules.note: 不 + verb + result is correct only in 'if not' sentences: 不做完作业不能出去玩. In a plain statement it is an error.

rules.rule: 'Don't!' is 别 or 不要 + verb; 不用 + verb means 'you don't need to'. Bare 不 or 没 cannot give an order. Adding 了 at the end means 'stop doing it'.
rules.pattern: (你) + 别 / 不要 / 不用 + Verb + (了)

rules.note: 别 and 不要 are interchangeable in commands; 别 is a little more colloquial. 不要 with a first-person subject is not a command: 我不要 means 'I don't want it'.

contrasts.why: 有 is only ever negated with 没; 不有 does not exist, even for the present or future.

right.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù shàng kè
right.en: I didn't go to class yesterday.

contrasts.why: A specific past event that did not take place needs 没. 不去 would be 'am not going' or 'refuse to go'.
没 already says the action did not happen, so the 了 of completion has nothing to mark. (没来了 is heard for 'didn't come in the end'; a plain 'didn't come' has no 了.)

right.py: wǒ míng tiān bù qù gōng sī
right.en: I'm not going to the office tomorrow.

contrasts.why: 没 looks back at what has not happened so far; a future plan or decision is negated with 不.

right.py: zuó tiān de kǎo shì bù nán

contrasts.why: An adjective describes a quality, not an event, so it takes 不 even when the time is past.
会 is a modal verb and is negated with 不. 没会 only turns up as 还没(学)会 'haven't learned yet', not for a plain 'can't'.

right.py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi
right.en: I have never been to Shanghai.

contrasts.why: Verb + 过 is about experience up to now, so the negative is always 没; 过 stays in the sentence.

right.py: zhè ge zì wǒ méi kàn dǒng

contrasts.why: A result that was not reached is 没 + verb + result. For 'can't understand', 不 goes in the middle: 看不懂.
你不说话 only states that you are not talking. An order needs 别 or 不要.

right.py: wǒ hái méi chī zǎo fàn ne

contrasts.why: 'Not yet' is 还没 + verb: the action has not happened up to now. 不吃 would mean you do not or will not eat it.

cheat: 有 in the sentence? Always 没有, never 不有.
Didn't / hasn't / not yet / never have (还, 过, a past event) -> 没, and no 了.
Don't as a habit, won't, not going to, refuse -> 不.
Adjective, 是, 知道, 认识, 喜欢 or a modal (会, 可以, 应该, 想) -> 不, even with 昨天.
Result complement: 没听懂 = didn't understand, 听不懂 = can't understand.
Giving an order: 别 / 不要 = don't, 不用 = no need; bare 不 or 没 is not a command.
Both fit the verb? Check the English: isn't coming = 不来, didn't come = 没来.

items.q: 明天我___有时间，我们下周再去吧。
items.zh: 明天我没有时间，我们下周再去吧。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān wǒ men xià zhōu zài qù ba
items.en: I won't have time tomorrow; let's go next week.
items.why: Even for the future, 有 is negated with 没有. 不有 is wrong, and 明天 does not change that.

items.q: 姐姐没买那件衣服___。
items.zh: 姐姐没买那件衣服。
items.py: jiě jie méi mǎi nà jiàn yī fu
items.en: My older sister didn't buy that dress.
items.why: 没买 is complete on its own; adding 了 after the object is the typical error.

items.q: 爷爷上个星期没去医院___，他说不用去。
items.zh: 爷爷上个星期没去医院，他说不用去。
items.py: yé ye shàng ge xīng qī méi qù yī yuàn tā shuō bù yòng qù
items.en: Grandpa didn't go to the hospital last week; he said there was no need.
items.why: The visit did not take place, so 没去 stands without 了.

items.q: 下个月我们___搬家，还住在这里。
items.zh: 下个月我们不搬家，还住在这里。
items.py: xià ge yuè wǒ men bù bān jiā hái zhù zài zhè lǐ
items.en: We aren't moving next month; we'll stay here.
items.why: 下个月 is in the future and the sentence states a plan, so 不. 没 cannot negate an event that has not come yet as a plan.

items.src_py: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu gōng yuán
items.zh: 我家附近没有公园。
items.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu gōng yuán
items.en: There's no park near my home.
items.why: 有 is always negated with 没有, never 不有.

items.q: 昨天下了雨，一点儿也___热。
items.zh: 昨天下了雨，一点儿也不热。
items.py: zuó tiān xià le yǔ yī diǎn r yě bù rè
items.en: It rained yesterday and it wasn't hot at all.
items.why: 热 is an adjective and 一点儿也 needs 不 even though the day was yesterday. 没热 is wrong.

items.q: 我爸爸平时___喝咖啡。
items.zh: 我爸爸平时不喝咖啡。
items.py: wǒ bà ba píng shí bù hē kā fēi
items.en: My dad doesn't usually drink coffee.
items.why: 平时 marks a habit, and a habit is negated with 不. 没 would report one single occasion that did not happen.

items.q: 菜我已经买好了，你___再去超市了。
items.zh: 菜我已经买好了，你不用再去超市了。
items.py: cài wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo le nǐ bù yòng zài qù chāo shì le
items.en: I've already bought the food; you don't need to go to the supermarket again.
items.why: The sense is no need, so 不用. 没 only denies a past event.

items.q: 弟弟昨天没做作业___，老师很生气。
items.zh: 弟弟昨天没做作业，老师很生气。
items.py: dì di zuó tiān méi zuò zuò yè lǎo shī hěn shēng qì
items.en: My younger brother didn't do his homework yesterday and the teacher is angry.
items.why: The past event did not happen, so there is no 了 after 没做作业.

items.q: 我以前___知道这家饭馆这么有名。
items.zh: 我以前不知道这家饭馆这么有名。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián bù zhī dào zhè jiā fàn guǎn zhè me yǒu míng
items.en: I didn't know before that this restaurant was so famous.
items.why: Even with the past time word 以前, the state verb 知道 takes 不. 没 is the tempting choice because of the past meaning.

items.s: 你们小区有不有公园？
items.s_py: nǐ men xiǎo qū yǒu bù yǒu gōng yuán
items.zh: 你们小区有没有公园？
items.py: nǐ men xiǎo qū yǒu méi yǒu gōng yuán
items.en: Does your neighborhood have a park?
items.why: The A-not-A question for 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is not Chinese.

items.q: 他昨天没来___。
items.zh: 他昨天没来。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi lái
items.en: He didn't come yesterday.
items.why: 没 already denies the event, so the 了 of completion is dropped. 没来了 would suggest he no longer comes.

items.q: 今天___冷，你穿一件衣服就行。
items.zh: 今天不冷，你穿一件衣服就行。
items.py: jīn tiān bù lěng nǐ chuān yī jiàn yī fu jiù xíng
items.en: It isn't cold today; one layer is enough.
items.why: Adjectives are negated with 不. 没冷 is not used to say that the weather is not cold.

items.q: 他昨天说要来，可是最后___来。
items.zh: 他昨天说要来，可是最后没来。
items.py: tā zuó tiān shuō yào lái kě shì zuì hòu méi lái
items.en: He said yesterday he'd come, but in the end he didn't turn up.
items.why: It reports that the event did not happen: 没来. 不来 would state a decision or refusal.

items.src_py: zhè ge zì wǒ kàn dǒng le
items.zh: 这个字我看不懂。
items.py: zhè ge zì wǒ kàn bù dǒng
items.en: I can't make out this character.
items.why: Cannot reach the result: 不 between 看 and 懂 (看不懂). 没看懂 would say only that it did not happen.

items.q: 我___会开车，我每天坐地铁。
items.zh: 我不会开车，我每天坐地铁。
items.py: wǒ bù huì kāi chē wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě
items.en: I can't drive; I take the subway every day.
items.why: 会 is a modal verb and modals take 不 in front of them. 没会 is impossible.

items.q: 老师说得太快，我听___懂。
items.zh: 老师说得太快，我听不懂。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: The teacher speaks too fast; I can't understand.
items.why: Cannot reach the result: 不 goes between verb and complement (听不懂). 没 cannot sit here.

items.q: 谢谢你，不过你___帮我拿包，我自己可以。
items.zh: 谢谢你，不过你不用帮我拿包，我自己可以。
items.py: xiè xie nǐ bù guò nǐ bù yòng bāng wǒ ná bāo wǒ zì jǐ kě yǐ
items.en: Thanks, but you don't need to carry my bag; I can do it myself.
items.why: No need to is 不用. 没 only denies something that already happened, so it cannot mean you needn't carry my bag now.

items.q: 对不起，我___认识这条路。
items.zh: 对不起，我不认识这条路。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ bù rèn shi zhè tiáo lù
items.en: Sorry, I don't know this road.
items.why: 认识 is a state verb meaning be familiar with, and state verbs take 不. 没认识 is not said for this meaning.

items.q: 老师问我周末去不去爬山，我说我___去，因为要在家陪奶奶。
items.zh: 老师问我周末去不去爬山，我说我不去，因为要在家陪奶奶。
items.py: lǎo shī wèn wǒ zhōu mò qù bu qù pá shān wǒ shuō wǒ bù qù yīn wèi yào zài jiā péi nǎi nai
items.en: The teacher asked whether I'd go hiking at the weekend and I said I'm not going because I have to stay with Grandma.
items.why: The answer is about a future plan: 不去. 没去 would say it did not happen.

items.zh: 这里不能停车。
items.py: zhè lǐ bù néng tíng chē
items.en: You can't park here.
items.why: 不 stands before the modal 能, not before 停车.

items.q: 我找___到我的钥匙了。
items.zh: 我找不到我的钥匙了。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de yào shi le
items.en: I can't find my keys.
items.why: Potential complement: verb + 不 + result, so 找不到. 找没到 is not a form.

items.q: 这条路在修，你们___走这边，请走那边。
items.zh: 这条路在修，你们别走这边，请走那边。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù zài xiū nǐ men bié zǒu zhè biān qǐng zǒu nà biān
items.en: The road is being repaired; don't go this way, please go that way.
items.why: Telling people not to do something is 别. 不用 means that there is no need to.

items.zh: 我昨天没去超市。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù chāo shì
items.en: I didn't go to the supermarket yesterday.
items.why: 没 stands right before the verb 去. The time word 昨天 may come before or after the subject.

items.q: 过马路的时候，你___看手机。
items.zh: 过马路的时候，你不要看手机。
items.py: guò mǎ lù de shí hou nǐ bù yào kàn shǒu jī
items.en: Don't look at your phone when you cross the road.
items.why: A prohibition needs 别 or 不要. 没 only denies that something happened.

items.zh: 爸爸平时不开车上班。
items.py: bà ba píng shí bù kāi chē shàng bān
items.en: Dad doesn't usually drive to work.
items.why: The habit word 平时 comes before 不, and 不 comes right before the verb 开车.

items.s: 你们不说话！
items.s_py: nǐ men bù shuō huà
items.zh: 你们别说话！
items.py: nǐ men bié shuō huà
items.en: Don't talk!
items.why: Bare 不 only states that you are not talking. An order needs 别 or 不要.

items.q: 你___应该一个人走夜路，太危险了。
items.zh: 你不应该一个人走夜路，太危险了。
items.py: nǐ bù yīng gāi yī gè rén zǒu yè lù tài wēi xiǎn le
items.en: You shouldn't walk alone at night; it's too dangerous.
items.why: 应该 is a modal, so 不 goes before it. 没应该 is not possible.

items.q: 房间太小了，这么多东西放___下。
items.zh: 房间太小了，这么多东西放不下。
items.py: fáng jiān tài xiǎo le zhè me duō dōng xi fàng bù xià
items.en: The room is too small; all this stuff can't fit.
items.why: Impossible by nature: verb + 不 + result (放不下). 没 before the verb would say it was not put down.

items.s: 天还没黑，孩子们还在楼下玩。
items.s_py: tiān hái méi hēi hái zi men hái zài lóu xià wán
items.zh: 天还没黑，孩子们还在楼下玩。
items.py: tiān hái méi hēi hái zi men hái zài lóu xià wán
items.en: It isn't dark yet and the kids are still playing downstairs.
items.why: 还没 + adjective is correct when a change has not happened yet.

items.s: 我小时候不喝牛奶，现在每天早上都喝。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù hē niú nǎi xiàn zài měi tiān zǎo shang dōu hē
items.zh: 我小时候不喝牛奶，现在每天早上都喝。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù hē niú nǎi xiàn zài měi tiān zǎo shang dōu hē
items.en: I didn't drink milk when I was little, but I drink it every morning now.
items.why: A past habit takes 不 even with 小时候.

items.s: 老师讲的我不听懂。
items.s_py: lǎo shī jiǎng de wǒ bù tīng dǒng
items.zh: 老师讲的我没听懂。
items.py: lǎo shī jiǎng de wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
items.why: A result not reached is 没 + verb + result. 不听懂 is not a form.

items.q: 我___知道银行在哪儿，你问问那位警察吧。
items.zh: 我不知道银行在哪儿，你问问那位警察吧。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào yín háng zài nǎ r nǐ wèn wen nà wèi jǐng chá ba
items.en: I don't know where the bank is; ask that police officer.
items.why: 知道 is a state, not an event, so it is negated with 不. 没知道 is not a normal sentence.

items.q: 我妹妹才三岁，现在___会自己洗衣服。
items.zh: 我妹妹才三岁，现在不会自己洗衣服。
items.py: wǒ mèi mei cái sān suì xiàn zài bù huì zì jǐ xǐ yī fu
items.en: My little sister is only three, so she can't wash her own clothes.
items.why: The modal 会 (can, know how to) is negated with 不 in front of it, whatever the time. 没会 is not said.

items.zh: 你有没有兄弟姐妹。
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi
items.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
items.why: The question form of 有 is 有没有, never 有不有.

items.q: 下雨了，我们___想出去逛街了。
items.zh: 下雨了，我们不想出去逛街了。
items.py: xià yǔ le wǒ men bù xiǎng chū qù guàng jiē le
items.en: It's raining, so we don't want to go shopping any more.
items.why: 想 (want to) is a modal and is negated with 不. 没想 plus the final 了 does not fit.

items.q: 我爷爷___喜欢住在高楼里，他觉得上下楼太麻烦。
items.zh: 我爷爷不喜欢住在高楼里，他觉得上下楼太麻烦。
items.py: wǒ yé ye bù xǐ huan zhù zài gāo lóu lǐ tā jué de shàng xià lóu tài má fan
items.en: My grandpa doesn't like living in a high-rise; he finds going up and down too much trouble.
items.why: 喜欢 is a state of mind and takes 不. 没喜欢 is not said, whatever the time.

items.q: 我们昨天没去公园___，因为下雨了。
items.zh: 我们昨天没去公园，因为下雨了。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi qù gōng yuán yīn wèi xià yǔ le
items.en: We didn't go to the park yesterday because it rained.
items.why: In the first clause 没去 is enough. The 了 that does belong is in 下雨了, a changed situation.

items.q: 我小时候家里___有电视，晚上大家都听广播。
items.zh: 我小时候家里没有电视，晚上大家都听广播。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou jiā lǐ méi yǒu diàn shì wǎn shang dà jiā dōu tīng guǎng bō
items.en: When I was little we had no TV at home; in the evening everyone listened to the radio.
items.why: Not having something in the past is still 没有. The past time word 小时候 never turns it into 不有.

items.s: 他说他今天不来，所以我们先开始吧。
items.s_py: tā shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái suǒ yǐ wǒ men xiān kāi shǐ ba
items.zh: 他说他今天不来，所以我们先开始吧。
items.py: tā shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái suǒ yǐ wǒ men xiān kāi shǐ ba
items.en: He says he isn't coming today, so let's start first.
items.why: Today is not over; his plan is not to come, so 不 is correct.

items.q: 不是我不想帮你，我真的___会修这台洗衣机。
items.zh: 不是我不想帮你，我真的不会修这台洗衣机。
items.py: bù shì wǒ bù xiǎng bāng nǐ wǒ zhēn de bù huì xiū zhè tái xǐ yī jī
items.en: It's not that I don't want to help you; I really can't fix this washing machine.
items.why: The ability verb 会 is negated with 不, before 会 and not before 修. 没会 is not said.

items.q: 地图上的字太小了，我___看清楚路名，只好问路人。
items.zh: 地图上的字太小了，我没看清楚路名，只好问路人。
items.py: dì tú shàng de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ méi kàn qīng chu lù míng zhǐ hǎo wèn lù rén
items.en: The writing on the map was too small and I couldn't make out the street name, so I had to ask a passer-by.
items.why: A result not achieved on one occasion: 没看清楚. 不看清楚 as a plain statement is wrong.

items.s: 我们好久没见面了。
items.s_py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn miàn le
items.zh: 我们好久没见面了。
items.py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn miàn le
items.en: We haven't seen each other for ages.
items.why: 好久没...了 is a correct pattern: the time since something last happened. It does not negate a completed action.

items.q: 我___有姐姐，只有一个哥哥。
items.zh: 我没有姐姐，只有一个哥哥。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu jiě jie zhǐ yǒu yī gè gē ge
items.en: I don't have an older sister, only an older brother.
items.why: 有 is negated only with 没. 不有 does not exist.

items.q: 爸爸昨晚___在看电视，他在书房工作。
items.zh: 爸爸昨晚没在看电视，他在书房工作。
items.py: bà ba zuó wǎn méi zài kàn diàn shì tā zài shū fáng gōng zuò
items.en: Dad wasn't watching TV last night; he was working in the study.
items.why: Denying an action that was in progress at a past time is 没 + 在 + verb. 不在看 does not fit a specific moment last night.

items.s: 我昨天请他吃饭，他不来，说太忙。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān qǐng tā chī fàn tā bù lái shuō tài máng
items.zh: 我昨天请他吃饭，他不来，说太忙。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qǐng tā chī fàn tā bù lái shuō tài máng
items.en: I invited him to dinner yesterday and he wouldn't come; he said he was too busy.
items.why: 不 about a past moment means a refusal then: he would not come. 没来 would only report that he did not.

items.q: 我今天早上没吃早饭___。
items.zh: 我今天早上没吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: I didn't have breakfast this morning.
items.why: Negating a completed action: 没 comes in and 了 goes out.

items.q: 我弟弟从来___去过动物园，所以很想去。
items.zh: 我弟弟从来没去过动物园，所以很想去。
items.py: wǒ dì di cóng lái méi qù guo dòng wù yuán suǒ yǐ hěn xiǎng qù
items.en: My younger brother has never been to the zoo, so he really wants to go.
items.why: 从来没 + verb + 过 states an experience never had. 从来不 + 过 is not possible.

items.q: 妈妈没给我买那个玩具___，所以我很不高兴。
items.zh: 妈妈没给我买那个玩具，所以我很不高兴。
items.py: mā ma méi gěi wǒ mǎi nà ge wán jù suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn bù gāo xìng
items.en: Mom didn't buy me that toy, so I'm unhappy.
items.why: 没 negates the completed purchase, so 了 must not be added.

items.s: 你不用来接我，我自己坐地铁回去。
items.s_py: nǐ bù yòng lái jiē wǒ wǒ zì jǐ zuò dì tiě huí qù
items.zh: 你不用来接我，我自己坐地铁回去。
items.py: nǐ bù yòng lái jiē wǒ wǒ zì jǐ zuò dì tiě huí qù
items.en: You don't need to pick me up; I'll take the subway home.
items.why: 不用 means there is no need to and is correct here.

items.q: 这个房间___大，住三个人有点儿挤。
items.zh: 这个房间不大，住三个人有点儿挤。
items.py: zhè ge fáng jiān bù dà zhù sān gè rén yǒu diǎn r jǐ
items.en: This room isn't big; three people would be a bit cramped.
items.why: A quality of the room is described with an adjective, so 不 is required. 没大 does not exist.

items.q: 我给姐姐打了好几次电话，她都___接，可能在开会。
items.zh: 我给姐姐打了好几次电话，她都没接，可能在开会。
items.py: wǒ gěi jiě jie dǎ le hǎo jǐ cì diàn huà tā dōu méi jiē kě néng zài kāi huì
items.en: I called my sister several times and she didn't pick up; she may be in a meeting.
items.why: The calls already happened and each time she did not answer: 没. 不接 would mean she refuses to pick up.

items.q: 我昨天___找到那家饭馆，所以只好回家做饭。
items.zh: 我昨天没找到那家饭馆，所以只好回家做饭。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi zhǎo dào nà jiā fàn guǎn suǒ yǐ zhǐ hǎo huí jiā zuò fàn
items.en: I didn't find that restaurant yesterday, so I had to go home and cook.
items.why: A past result not reached: 没 + verb + result. 不找到 is not a form for a plain past statement.

items.q: 周末我们一般___在家吃饭，常常去饭馆。
items.zh: 周末我们一般不在家吃饭，常常去饭馆。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men yī bān bù zài jiā chī fàn cháng cháng qù fàn guǎn
items.en: We usually don't eat at home on weekends; we often go to restaurants.
items.why: 一般 and 常常 describe a routine, so the negative is 不. 没 would describe one particular weekend.

items.q: 因为早上地铁太挤，我下周开始___坐地铁上班了，改骑自行车。
items.zh: 因为早上地铁太挤，我下周开始不坐地铁上班了，改骑自行车。
items.py: yīn wèi zǎo shang dì tiě tài jǐ wǒ xià zhōu kāi shǐ bù zuò dì tiě shàng bān le gǎi qí zì xíng chē
items.en: Because the subway is too crowded in the morning, from next week I won't take it to work; I'll cycle instead.
items.why: 下周开始 sets a new routine from next week, so 不...了. 没 would claim the subway was not taken in the past.

items.q: 我哥哥昨天___回家。
items.zh: 我哥哥昨天没回家。
items.py: wǒ gē ge zuó tiān méi huí jiā
items.en: My older brother didn't come home yesterday.
items.why: A specific event yesterday that did not happen takes 没. 不回家 would mean he refuses or does not plan to.

items.q: 作业太多了，我今天晚上做___完。
items.zh: 作业太多了，我今天晚上做不完。
items.py: zuò yè tài duō le wǒ jīn tiān wǎn shang zuò bù wán
items.en: There's so much homework; I can't finish it tonight.
items.why: Tonight has not happened yet and the point is inability, so 做不完. 没 cannot go inside the verb and result.

items.zh: 他说他明天不来。
items.py: tā shuō tā míng tiān bù lái
items.en: He says he isn't coming tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 is the future, so 不 goes before 来. The subject and 明天 can swap.

items.q: 上个星期我们___出门，一直在家休息。
items.zh: 上个星期我们没出门，一直在家休息。
items.py: shàng ge xīng qī wǒ men méi chū mén yī zhí zài jiā xiū xi
items.en: We didn't go out last week; we rested at home the whole time.
items.why: 上个星期 is a finished period in which going out did not happen: 没. 不出门 would describe a rule or a refusal.

items.q: 这条街上___有银行，只有一家小超市。
items.zh: 这条街上没有银行，只有一家小超市。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē shang méi yǒu yín háng zhǐ yǒu yī jiā xiǎo chāo shì
items.en: There's no bank on this street, only a small supermarket.
items.why: Existence of a bank is denied with 没有. 不有 is not Chinese.

items.q: 我哥哥平时很少坐公交车，今天也___坐，是开车去的。
items.zh: 我哥哥平时很少坐公交车，今天也没坐，是开车去的。
items.py: wǒ gē ge píng shí hěn shǎo zuò gōng jiāo chē jīn tiān yě méi zuò shì kāi chē qù de
items.en: My brother rarely takes the bus, and today he didn't take it either; he drove.
items.why: 是...的 shows today is over, so 没坐 reports what did not happen. 不 describes the habit, not this day.

items.q: 虽然朋友们都去了，但是我因为要照顾奶奶，所以没去___。
items.zh: 虽然朋友们都去了，但是我因为要照顾奶奶，所以没去。
items.py: suī rán péng you men dōu qù le dàn shì wǒ yīn wèi yào zhào gù nǎi nai suǒ yǐ méi qù
items.en: Although my friends all went, I didn't go because I had to look after Grandma.
items.why: A contrast: 都去了 has 了 for a completed action, but 没去 has none. Do not copy the 了 into the negative.

items.q: 我___去过上海，你呢？
items.zh: 我没去过上海，你呢？
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi nǐ ne
items.en: I've never been to Shanghai. What about you?
items.why: Verb + 过 about experience is always negated with 没, and 过 stays. 不去过 is a classic error.

items.q: 这个字我___看懂，你能教我吗？
items.zh: 这个字我没看懂，你能教我吗？
items.py: zhè ge zì wǒ méi kàn dǒng nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma
items.en: I didn't understand this character; can you teach me?
items.why: The result was not reached: 没 + verb + result. 我不看懂 is a typical error.

items.zh: 我从来不在床上吃东西。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù zài chuáng shang chī dōng xi
items.en: I never eat in bed.
items.why: 从来不 states a standing habit, and 不 stays before the verb. 在床上 may come before or after 从来不.

items.src_py: nǐ zài jiào shì lǐ chī dōng xi
items.zh: 你别在教室里吃东西。
items.py: nǐ bié zài jiào shì lǐ chī dōng xi
items.en: Don't eat in the classroom.
items.why: A prohibition is 别 before the verb phrase. 不 or 没 alone cannot give an order.

items.q: 你家有___有电梯？
items.zh: 你家有没有电梯？
items.py: nǐ jiā yǒu méi yǒu diàn tī
items.en: Does your home have an elevator?
items.why: The A-not-A question of 有 is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist, since 有 is negated only with 没.

items.q: 太贵了，这个沙发我___买。
items.zh: 太贵了，这个沙发我不买。
items.py: tài guì le zhè ge shā fā wǒ bù mǎi
items.en: It's too expensive. I won't buy this sofa.
items.why: The speaker decides now not to buy, which is 不. 没买 would say the sofa was not bought in the past.

items.q: 如果你家附近___有公交车站，你可以走路去坐地铁。
items.zh: 如果你家附近没有公交车站，你可以走路去坐地铁。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu gōng jiāo chē zhàn nǐ kě yǐ zǒu lù qù zuò dì tiě
items.en: If there is no bus stop near your home, you can walk to take the subway.
items.why: Even in an if-clause, the negative of 有 is 没有, not 不有.

items.q: 我以后___在客厅吃零食了。
items.zh: 我以后不在客厅吃零食了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ hòu bù zài kè tīng chī líng shí le
items.en: From now on I won't eat snacks in the living room.
items.why: 以后 looks forward and 不...了 means a new decision to stop. 没 is about past non-occurrence and does not fit 以后.

items.q: 在图书馆里___能大声说话。
items.zh: 在图书馆里不能大声说话。
items.py: zài tú shū guǎn lǐ bù néng dà shēng shuō huà
items.en: You can't speak loudly in the library.
items.why: A rule about what is allowed uses the modal 能 with 不 in front. 没 would say someone did not manage to speak loudly.

items.s: 外婆昨天不来我们家。
items.s_py: wài pó zuó tiān bù lái wǒ men jiā
items.zh: 外婆昨天没来我们家。
items.py: wài pó zuó tiān méi lái wǒ men jiā
items.en: Grandma didn't come to our house yesterday.
items.why: A past event that did not take place needs 没.

items.s: 我昨天没想到你会来。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān méi xiǎng dào nǐ huì lái
items.zh: 我昨天没想到你会来。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi xiǎng dào nǐ huì lái
items.en: I didn't expect you to come yesterday.
items.why: 没想到 is a fixed result form (did not think of / expect), so 没 is right here.

items.q: 弟弟不喜欢吃肉，所以他平时___吃肉。
items.zh: 弟弟不喜欢吃肉，所以他平时不吃肉。
items.py: dì di bù xǐ huan chī ròu suǒ yǐ tā píng shí bù chī ròu
items.en: My brother doesn't like meat, so he doesn't usually eat it.
items.why: 平时 gives a habit: 不吃. 没吃 would claim he did not eat on one occasion.

items.zh: 楼下没有超市。
items.py: lóu xià méi yǒu chāo shì
items.en: There's no supermarket downstairs.
items.why: Existence of a place is denied with 没有, placed before the noun.

items.s: 我从来不去过上海。
items.s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù qù guo shàng hǎi
items.zh: 我从来没去过上海。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo shàng hǎi
items.en: I've never been to Shanghai.
items.why: Verb + 过 for experience is negated with 没, and 过 stays.

items.s: 我家的旧电视坏了，现在没有电视了。
items.s_py: wǒ jiā de jiù diàn shì huài le xiàn zài méi yǒu diàn shì le
items.zh: 我家的旧电视坏了，现在没有电视了。
items.py: wǒ jiā de jiù diàn shì huài le xiàn zài méi yǒu diàn shì le
items.en: Our old TV broke, so now we have no TV.
items.why: 没有 + noun + 了 is correct for no longer having something. The 了 marks the change.

items.q: 我___愿意搬到郊区，那里离公司太远。
items.zh: 我不愿意搬到郊区，那里离公司太远。
items.py: wǒ bù yuàn yì bān dào jiāo qū nà lǐ lí gōng sī tài yuǎn
items.en: I'm not willing to move to the suburbs; it's too far from my company.
items.why: 愿意 expresses willingness and is negated with 不, placed before 愿意 and not before 搬.

items.q: 今天早上我___吃早饭，所以现在很饿。
items.zh: 今天早上我没吃早饭，所以现在很饿。
items.py: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ méi chī zǎo fàn suǒ yǐ xiàn zài hěn è
items.en: I didn't eat breakfast this morning, so I'm hungry now.
items.why: 今天早上 is already over and the meal did not happen: 没吃. 不吃 would be a habit or refusal.

items.s: 姐姐昨天没回家了。
items.s_py: jiě jie zuó tiān méi huí jiā le
items.zh: 姐姐昨天没回家。
items.py: jiě jie zuó tiān méi huí jiā
items.en: My older sister didn't come home yesterday.
items.why: Denying a completed action takes 没 and no 了.

items.s: 她没认识我们的老师。
items.s_py: tā méi rèn shi wǒ men de lǎo shī
items.zh: 她不认识我们的老师。
items.py: tā bù rèn shi wǒ men de lǎo shī
items.en: She doesn't know our teacher.
items.why: 认识 is a state verb and takes 不.

items.s: 明天我没去超市。
items.s_py: míng tiān wǒ méi qù chāo shì
items.zh: 明天我不去超市。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ bù qù chāo shì
items.en: I'm not going to the supermarket tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 is the future, so 不. 没 looks back at what has not happened.

items.s: 我没会做饭，都是妈妈做。
items.s_py: wǒ méi huì zuò fàn dōu shì mā ma zuò
items.zh: 我不会做饭，都是妈妈做。
items.py: wǒ bù huì zuò fàn dōu shì mā ma zuò
items.en: I can't cook; my mom does it all.
items.why: 会 is a modal verb and takes 不, never 没.

items.q: 妈妈还___做晚饭呢，你再等一会儿。
items.zh: 妈妈还没做晚饭呢，你再等一会儿。
items.py: mā ma hái méi zuò wǎn fàn ne nǐ zài děng yī huì r
items.en: Mom hasn't made dinner yet; wait a little longer.
items.why: 还没...呢 means not yet, so 没. 还不 would suggest that she is not going to cook.

items.q: 他昨天一整天都___回家，我很担心。
items.zh: 他昨天一整天都没回家，我很担心。
items.py: tā zuó tiān yī zhěng tiān dōu méi huí jiā wǒ hěn dān xīn
items.en: He didn't come home all day yesterday, and I'm worried.
items.why: The non-occurrence is placed in yesterday, so 没. 不回家 would mean he refuses to go home.

items.zh: 请别在楼道里抽烟。
items.py: qǐng bié zài lóu dào lǐ chōu yān
items.en: Please don't smoke in the stairwell.
items.why: 别 comes before the whole 在 + place + verb phrase, after 请.

items.q: 我家附近___有地铁站。
items.zh: 我家附近没有地铁站。
items.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu dì tiě zhàn
items.en: There's no subway station near my home.
items.why: There is not a... uses 没有, and 不有 is never possible.

items.s: 这么远，我走不到地铁站。
items.s_py: zhè me yuǎn wǒ zǒu bù dào dì tiě zhàn
items.zh: 这么远，我走不到地铁站。
items.py: zhè me yuǎn wǒ zǒu bù dào dì tiě zhàn
items.en: It's so far that I can't walk to the subway station.
items.why: Verb + 不 + result is correct for what cannot be done.

items.q: 明天我妈妈___去超市。
items.zh: 明天我妈妈不去超市。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ mā ma bù qù chāo shì
items.en: My mom isn't going to the supermarket tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 is the future, and a plan not to do something takes 不. 没 only looks back at what has not happened so far.

items.s: 不做完作业不能看电视。
items.s_py: bù zuò wán zuò yè bù néng kàn diàn shì
items.zh: 不做完作业不能看电视。
items.py: bù zuò wán zuò yè bù néng kàn diàn shì
items.en: You can't watch TV unless you finish your homework.
items.why: In an if-not sentence, 不 + verb + result is correct.

items.q: 他___是我哥哥，他是我表哥。
items.zh: 他不是我哥哥，他是我表哥。
items.py: tā bù shì wǒ gē ge tā shì wǒ biǎo gē
items.en: He isn't my older brother; he's my cousin.
items.why: 是 is always negated with 不 and never with 没, so 他不是 is the only form.

items.zh: 奶奶不知道这件事。
items.py: nǎi nai bù zhī dào zhè jiàn shì
items.en: Grandma doesn't know about this.
items.why: 知道 is a state verb negated with 不 placed directly before it. Fronting 这件事 is also fine.

items.s: 教室里不有人。
items.s_py: jiào shì lǐ bù yǒu rén
items.zh: 教室里没有人。
items.py: jiào shì lǐ méi yǒu rén
items.en: There is nobody in the classroom.
items.why: 有 is only ever negated with 没, so 不有 is never right.

items.q: 宝宝睡觉了，你们___说话了。
items.zh: 宝宝睡觉了，你们别说话了。
items.py: bǎo bao shuì jiào le nǐ men bié shuō huà le
items.en: The baby's asleep; stop talking.
items.why: An order to stop is 别...了. 不用 would mean there is no need to talk.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
items.zh: 我没听懂老师的话。
items.py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
items.en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
items.why: A result not reached: 没 + verb + result, and the 了 disappears.

items.q: 我请他来吃饭，可是他说他___来，因为他太忙了。
items.zh: 我请他来吃饭，可是他说他不来，因为他太忙了。
items.py: wǒ qǐng tā lái chī fàn kě shì tā shuō tā bù lái yīn wèi tā tài máng le
items.en: I invited him to dinner, but he says he isn't coming because he's too busy.
items.why: He states his decision about the coming meal: 不来. 没来 would report that he did not show up.

items.q: 这里___可以停车。
items.zh: 这里不可以停车。
items.py: zhè lǐ bù kě yǐ tíng chē
items.en: You can't park here.
items.why: 可以 is negated with 不 (不可以 = not allowed). 没可以 does not exist.

items.zh: 他没找到钥匙。
items.py: tā méi zhǎo dào yào shi
items.en: He didn't find the key.
items.why: The unachieved result is 没 + 找到, with 没 before the verb. Fronting the object 钥匙 is also correct.

items.src_py: dì di mǎi le nà běn shū
items.zh: 弟弟没买那本书。
items.py: dì di méi mǎi nà běn shū
items.en: My younger brother didn't buy that book.
items.why: The negative of a completed action uses 没 and drops 了.

items.q: 我在这座城市住了十年，可是还___去过那个公园。
items.zh: 我在这座城市住了十年，可是还没去过那个公园。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè zuò chéng shì zhù le shí nián kě shì hái méi qù guo nà ge gōng yuán
items.en: I've lived in this city for ten years but I still haven't been to that park.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 过 means has not yet had the experience. 还不去过 is ungrammatical.

items.q: 我平时___喝冷水，对胃不好。
items.zh: 我平时不喝冷水，对胃不好。
items.py: wǒ píng shí bù hē lěng shuǐ duì wèi bù hǎo
items.en: I don't usually drink cold water; it's bad for the stomach.
items.why: 平时 marks a habit, and a habit is negated with 不. 没 would report one single occasion that did not happen.

items.q: 明天我___去医院，我已经好了。
items.zh: 明天我不去医院，我已经好了。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ bù qù yī yuàn wǒ yǐ jīng hǎo le
items.en: I'm not going to the hospital tomorrow; I'm already better.
items.why: 明天 is the future and this is a decision, so 不. 没 only looks back at what has not happened so far.

items.q: 我小时候___吃药，妈妈每次都要哄我。
items.zh: 我小时候不吃药，妈妈每次都要哄我。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù chī yào mā ma měi cì dōu yào hǒng wǒ
items.en: When I was little I wouldn't take medicine; Mum had to coax me every time.
items.why: 每次 turns this into a past habit and refusal, which takes 不 even though the time is past. 没 would say one particular dose was missed.

items.q: 我今晚___熬夜了，要早点睡。
items.zh: 我今晚不熬夜了，要早点睡。
items.py: wǒ jīn wǎn bù áo yè le yào zǎo diǎn shuì
items.en: I won't stay up late tonight; I'm going to bed early.
items.why: 今晚 with a decision to sleep early is a plan, so 不. 没 cannot negate a future event.

items.q: 医生让我少吃盐，所以我以后___做太咸的菜，也不点外卖了。
items.zh: 医生让我少吃盐，所以我以后不做太咸的菜，也不点外卖了。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ shǎo chī yán suǒ yǐ wǒ yǐ hòu bù zuò tài xián de cài yě bù diǎn wài mài le
items.en: The doctor told me to eat less salt, so from now on I won't cook overly salty dishes or order takeout.
items.why: 以后 looks forward: a resolution takes 不. 没 would claim you did not cook salty food on some past occasion.

items.q: 明年夏天我打算戒掉甜饮料，一杯奶茶也___喝。
items.zh: 明年夏天我打算戒掉甜饮料，一杯奶茶也不喝。
items.py: míng nián xià tiān wǒ dǎ suàn jiè diào tián yǐn liào yī bēi nǎi chá yě bù hē
items.en: Next summer I plan to give up sweet drinks; I won't drink even one cup of milk tea.
items.why: The time is next summer and it is a plan, so 不. 没 is only for what has not happened up to now.

items.q: 昨天天气很好，一点儿也___冷。
items.zh: 昨天天气很好，一点儿也不冷。
items.py: zuó tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo yī diǎn r yě bù lěng
items.en: The weather was nice yesterday; it wasn't cold at all.
items.why: 冷 is an adjective, a quality rather than an event, so it takes 不 even for yesterday.

items.q: 这个手机___是我的，是我姐姐的。
items.zh: 这个手机不是我的，是我姐姐的。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī bú shì wǒ de shì wǒ jiě jie de
items.en: This phone isn't mine; it's my older sister's.
items.why: 是 is only ever negated with 不. 没是 does not exist.

items.q: 我___认识这个医生，你认识吗？
items.zh: 我不认识这个医生，你认识吗？
items.py: wǒ bù rèn shi zhè ge yī shēng nǐ rèn shi ma
items.en: I don't know this doctor; do you?
items.why: 认识 is a state verb, so 不. 没认识 is not said.

items.q: 我以前___知道手机也能当钱包用。
items.zh: 我以前不知道手机也能当钱包用。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián bù zhī dào shǒu jī yě néng dāng qián bāo yòng
items.en: I didn't know before that a phone can serve as a wallet.
items.why: 知道 is a state, so it takes 不 even with 以前. 没知道 is a common learner slip.

items.q: 昨天的检查结果___太好，医生让我再来一次。
items.zh: 昨天的检查结果不太好，医生让我再来一次。
items.py: zuó tiān de jiǎn chá jié guǒ bú tài hǎo yī shēng ràng wǒ zài lái yī cì
items.en: Yesterday's test results weren't great, so the doctor asked me to come again.
items.why: 好 here is a quality of the results, so 不太好. 没太好 would sound like something has not recovered.

items.q: 手机屏幕太脏了，视频一点也___清楚。
items.zh: 手机屏幕太脏了，视频一点也不清楚。
items.py: shǒu jī píng mù tài zāng le shì pín yī diǎn yě bù qīng chu
items.en: The phone screen is so dirty that the video isn't clear at all.
items.why: 清楚 is an adjective describing how the picture looks, so 不. 没 would need an event.

items.q: 直到上个月我才知道自己对花粉过敏，以前我一点也___知道。
items.zh: 直到上个月我才知道自己对花粉过敏，以前我一点也不知道。
items.py: zhí dào shàng ge yuè wǒ cái zhī dào zì jǐ duì huā fěn guò mǐn yǐ qián wǒ yī diǎn yě bù zhī dào
items.en: I only found out last month that I'm allergic to pollen; I never knew before.
items.why: 知道 is a state, so the negative is 不, and 一点也 strengthens it: 一点也不知道. 没知道 is a common learner slip, even with a past time word.

items.q: 我___会用这个软件，你教教我吧。
items.zh: 我不会用这个软件，你教教我吧。
items.py: wǒ bú huì yòng zhè ge ruǎn jiàn nǐ jiāo jiao wǒ ba
items.en: I don't know how to use this app; please teach me.
items.why: 会 is a modal verb and takes 不. 没会 is impossible.

items.q: 医生说我现在___能喝咖啡。
items.zh: 医生说我现在不能喝咖啡。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ xiàn zài bù néng hē kā fēi
items.en: The doctor says I can't drink coffee right now.
items.why: 能 is a modal, negated with 不 before it. 没能 means "failed to", which does not fit a rule from the doctor.

items.q: 我现在头疼，___想出门。
items.zh: 我现在头疼，不想出门。
items.py: wǒ xiàn zài tóu téng bù xiǎng chū mén
items.en: I have a headache now and don't want to go out.
items.why: 想 (want to) is a modal, and 现在 is a present state, so 不想. 没想 would be about not having thought of something.

items.q: 在飞机上手机___可以打电话，要调成飞行模式。
items.zh: 在飞机上手机不可以打电话，要调成飞行模式。
items.py: zài fēi jī shàng shǒu jī bù kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà yào tiáo chéng fēi xíng mó shì
items.en: On a plane you may not make phone calls; set the phone to flight mode.
items.why: 可以 is a permission modal and is negated with 不. 没可以 does not exist.

items.q: 你发烧了，___应该去上班，在家休息吧。
items.zh: 你发烧了，不应该去上班，在家休息吧。
items.py: nǐ fā shāo le bù yīng gāi qù shàng bān zài jiā xiū xi ba
items.en: You have a fever; you shouldn't go to work. Rest at home.
items.why: 应该 is a modal, so 不应该. 没应该 is never said.

items.q: 虽然医生反复解释过，他还是___愿意做手术，担心有风险。
items.zh: 虽然医生反复解释过，他还是不愿意做手术，担心有风险。
items.py: suī rán yī shēng fǎn fù jiě shì guo tā hái shi bù yuàn yì zuò shǒu shù dān xīn yǒu fēng xiǎn
items.en: Although the doctor explained it again and again, he is still unwilling to have the operation, as he worries about the risk.
items.why: 愿意 is a modal and keeps 不 even in a past setting. 没愿意 is not natural.

items.q: 奶奶___用智能手机，我来教她。
items.zh: 奶奶不会用智能手机，我来教她。
items.py: nǎi nai bú huì yòng zhì néng shǒu jī wǒ lái jiāo tā
items.en: Grandma doesn't know how to use a smartphone; I'll teach her.
items.why: 不 goes before the modal 会. 会不用 would put the negative on the main verb and does not make this meaning.

items.q: 我昨天___去上班，因为我发烧了。
items.zh: 我昨天没去上班，因为我发烧了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù shàng bān yīn wèi wǒ fā shāo le
items.en: I didn't go to work yesterday because I had a fever.
items.why: A specific past day on which the action did not happen needs 没. 不去 would be a refusal or a plan.

items.q: 医生还___来，我们再等一等。
items.zh: 医生还没来，我们再等一等。
items.py: yī shēng hái méi lái wǒ men zài děng yi děng
items.en: The doctor hasn't come yet; let's wait a bit longer.
items.why: 还没 means "not yet", something expected has not happened. 还不来 would be an impatient complaint, not a report.

items.q: 我的手机昨晚没电了，我___给你打电话。
items.zh: 我的手机昨晚没电了，我没给你打电话。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī zuó wǎn méi diàn le wǒ méi gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: My phone died last night, so I didn't call you.
items.why: 昨晚 is a finished time and the call did not happen, so 没. 不 would suggest you refused to call.

items.q: 我从来___在网上买过药。
items.zh: 我从来没在网上买过药。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi zài wǎng shàng mǎi guo yào
items.en: I have never bought medicine online.
items.why: Verb + 过 is an experience up to now, so its negative is 没. 不 cannot go with 过.

items.q: 妈妈___在看手机，她在看书。
items.zh: 妈妈没在看手机，她在看书。
items.py: mā ma méi zài kàn shǒu jī tā zài kàn shū
items.en: Mum isn't looking at her phone; she's reading.
items.why: Negating an action in progress (在 + verb) takes 没. 不 would sound like she habitually refuses to.

items.q: 这个软件我下载了，但是还___用过。
items.zh: 这个软件我下载了，但是还没用过。
items.py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn wǒ xià zài le dàn shì hái méi yòng guo
items.en: I downloaded this app but haven't used it yet.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 过 is "have not yet". 不 cannot combine with 过.

items.q: 到现在为止，我还___收到医院发来的检查报告。
items.zh: 到现在为止，我还没收到医院发来的检查报告。
items.py: dào xiàn zài wéi zhǐ wǒ hái méi shōu dào yī yuàn fā lái de jiǎn chá bào gào
items.en: So far I haven't received the test report from the hospital.
items.why: 到现在为止 plus 还 says it has not happened yet, so 没. 不收到 is not possible.

items.q: 他这辈子___住过院，所以很怕去医院。
items.zh: 他这辈子没住过院，所以很怕去医院。
items.py: tā zhè bèi zi méi zhù guo yuàn suǒ yǐ hěn pà qù yī yuàn
items.en: He has never been in hospital in his life, so he is afraid of going.
items.why: 住过院 is a lifetime experience, so 没 + verb + 过. 不 cannot be used with 过.

items.q: 我家___有网络，所以不能上网。
items.zh: 我家没有网络，所以不能上网。
items.py: wǒ jiā méi yǒu wǎng luò suǒ yǐ bù néng shàng wǎng
items.en: We have no internet at home, so I can't get online.
items.why: 有 is only negated with 没. 不有 does not exist.

items.q: 医院旁边___有银行，只有一家药店。
items.zh: 医院旁边没有银行，只有一家药店。
items.py: yī yuàn páng biān méi yǒu yín háng zhǐ yǒu yī jiā yào diàn
items.en: There is no bank next to the hospital, only a pharmacy.
items.why: Existence 有 is negated with 没有, never 不有.

items.q: 你有___有这个软件的账号？
items.zh: 你有没有这个软件的账号？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhè ge ruǎn jiàn de zhàng hào
items.en: Do you have an account for this app?
items.why: The A-not-A question for 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is not said.

items.q: 下个星期我___有时间去体检，下个月再说吧。
items.zh: 下个星期我没有时间去体检，下个月再说吧。
items.py: xià ge xīng qī wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān qù tǐ jiǎn xià ge yuè zài shuō ba
items.en: I won't have time for a check-up next week; let's talk about it next month.
items.why: Even for the future, 有 is negated with 没有. 不有时间 is wrong.

items.q: 这个房间里___有信号，你去阳台打电话吧。
items.zh: 这个房间里没有信号，你去阳台打电话吧。
items.py: zhè ge fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu xìn hào nǐ qù yáng tái dǎ diàn huà ba
items.en: There's no signal in this room; go make the call on the balcony.
items.why: "There is no signal" is 没有 + noun. 不有 is never used.

items.q: 他的手机里一个游戏也___有，只有几个学习软件。
items.zh: 他的手机里一个游戏也没有，只有几个学习软件。
items.py: tā de shǒu jī lǐ yī gè yóu xì yě méi yǒu zhǐ yǒu jǐ gè xué xí ruǎn jiàn
items.en: There isn't a single game on his phone, only a few study apps.
items.why: 一个...也 plus 有 is negated with 没有. 不有 is never possible.

items.q: 如果明天你___有空，我们就改成视频会议。
items.zh: 如果明天你没有空，我们就改成视频会议。
items.py: rú guǒ míng tiān nǐ méi yǒu kòng wǒ men jiù gǎi chéng shì pín huì yì
items.en: If you're not free tomorrow, we'll switch to a video meeting.
items.why: 有空 is built on 有, so its negative is 没有空 even in a future condition. 不有空 is wrong.

items.q: 听说那家诊所晚上___有医生值班，所以病人只能去大医院。
items.zh: 听说那家诊所晚上没有医生值班，所以病人只能去大医院。
items.py: tīng shuō nà jiā zhěn suǒ wǎn shang méi yǒu yī shēng zhí bān suǒ yǐ bìng rén zhǐ néng qù dà yī yuàn
items.en: I hear that clinic has no doctor on duty at night, so patients can only go to the big hospital.
items.why: The clause says no doctor exists on duty, which is 没有. 不有 is never used.

items.q: 他昨天没来上课___。
items.zh: 他昨天没来上课。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi lái shàng kè
items.en: He didn't come to class yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so there is no 了. Adding 了 is the typical error.

items.q: 我今天没吃药___，一会儿再吃。
items.zh: 我今天没吃药，一会儿再吃。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān méi chī yào yī huì r zài chī
items.en: I haven't taken my medicine today; I'll take it in a bit.
items.why: The negative of a completed action drops 了: 没吃药.

items.q: 弟弟昨晚没玩游戏___，他早早就睡了。
items.zh: 弟弟昨晚没玩游戏，他早早就睡了。
items.py: dì di zuó wǎn méi wán yóu xì tā zǎo zǎo jiù shuì le
items.en: My younger brother didn't play games last night; he went to bed early.
items.why: The first clause is a negated completed action: 没 replaces 了. The later 睡了 is a different, positive clause.

items.q: 他昨天没带手机___，所以没接到你的电话。
items.zh: 他昨天没带手机，所以没接到你的电话。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi dài shǒu jī suǒ yǐ méi jiē dào nǐ de diàn huà
items.en: He didn't bring his phone yesterday, so he didn't get your call.
items.why: 没带手机 is complete without 了; 了 does not follow 没 to mark a finished event.

items.q: 她今天早上没量体温___，护士提醒了她。
items.zh: 她今天早上没量体温，护士提醒了她。
items.py: tā jīn tiān zǎo shang méi liáng tǐ wēn hù shi tí xǐng le tā
items.en: She didn't take her temperature this morning, and the nurse reminded her.
items.why: The omitted action is negated with 没 and no 了. The 了 after 提醒 belongs to a different, completed action.

items.q: 我昨天没给他发照片___，手机坏了。
items.zh: 我昨天没给他发照片，手机坏了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi gěi tā fā zhào piàn shǒu jī huài le
items.en: I didn't send him the photos yesterday because my phone broke.
items.why: 发照片 did not happen, so 没 and no 了.

items.q: 老板上午没批准他请假___，他只好带病去上班。
items.zh: 老板上午没批准他请假，他只好带病去上班。
items.py: lǎo bǎn shàng wǔ méi pī zhǔn tā qǐng jià tā zhǐ hǎo dài bìng qù shàng bān
items.en: The boss didn't approve his leave this morning, so he had to go to work sick.
items.why: The approval did not take place: 没批准 with no 了. 没...了 here would suggest a changed situation.

items.q: 我昨天忘了充电，所以今天早上手机没响___，上班迟到了。
items.zh: 我昨天忘了充电，所以今天早上手机没响，上班迟到了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wàng le chōng diàn suǒ yǐ jīn tiān zǎo shang shǒu jī méi xiǎng shàng bān chí dào le
items.en: I forgot to charge it yesterday, so my phone didn't ring this morning and I was late for work.
items.why: This morning is a specific past event that did not happen, so 没响 with no 了. The 了 on 忘了 and 迟到了 belong to completed actions.

items.q: 他说他今天___来了，他不舒服。
items.zh: 他说他今天不来了，他不舒服。
items.py: tā shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái le tā bù shū fu
items.en: He says he isn't coming today; he doesn't feel well.
items.why: The English is a decision, "isn't coming", so 不来. 没来 would report that he did not show up.

items.q: 我们等了一个小时，医生还是___来。
items.zh: 我们等了一个小时，医生还是没来。
items.py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí yī shēng hái shi méi lái
items.en: We waited an hour and the doctor still didn't come.
items.why: 等了一个小时 is a past event and "didn't come" reports a fact, so 没. 不来 would mean the doctor refuses to come.

items.q: 弟弟一听要吃药就摇头，说什么也___吃。
items.zh: 弟弟一听要吃药就摇头，说什么也不吃。
items.py: dì di yī tīng yào chī yào jiù yáo tóu shuō shén me yě bù chī
items.en: My brother shakes his head at the mention of medicine and won't take it no matter what.
items.why: 说什么也 plus a refusal means "no matter what, I won't", so 不吃. 没吃 would only report that he did not take it, and cannot follow 说什么也.

items.q: 他昨天说他今天___来，可是今天一早他就到了。
items.zh: 他昨天说他今天不来，可是今天一早他就到了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái kě shì jīn tiān yī zǎo tā jiù dào le
items.en: Yesterday he said he wasn't coming today, but he arrived first thing this morning.
items.why: What he said was a plan for today, "wouldn't come", so 不来. 没来 would contradict that he arrived.

items.q: 我今天早上___吃早饭，所以现在肚子很饿。
items.zh: 我今天早上没吃早饭，所以现在肚子很饿。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi chī zǎo fàn suǒ yǐ xiàn zài dù zi hěn è
items.en: I didn't have breakfast this morning, so I'm very hungry now.
items.why: This morning is a finished event that did not happen, so 没. 不吃 would mean you do not eat breakfast as a rule.

items.q: 我___吃辣的，吃了会胃疼。
items.zh: 我不吃辣的，吃了会胃疼。
items.py: wǒ bù chī là de chī le huì wèi téng
items.en: I don't eat spicy food; it gives me a stomachache.
items.why: The second clause 吃了会胃疼 gives a standing reason, so this is a habit: 不. 没 would be one meal.

items.q: 我昨天给他打了三次电话，可他一次也___接。
items.zh: 我昨天给他打了三次电话，可他一次也没接。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi tā dǎ le sān cì diàn huà kě tā yī cì yě méi jiē
items.en: I called him three times yesterday, but he didn't pick up even once.
items.why: These are three specific past calls, so 没接. 一次也不接 would be a general refusal.

items.q: 妹妹从小就___吃青菜，现在也是。
items.zh: 妹妹从小就不吃青菜，现在也是。
items.py: mèi mei cóng xiǎo jiù bù chī qīng cài xiàn zài yě shì
items.en: My younger sister has never eaten greens since she was little, and still doesn't.
items.why: 从小就...现在也是 describes a lifelong habit, so 不. 没 would report a single missed meal.

items.q: 医生建议他住院观察，但他觉得没必要，所以决定___住院。
items.zh: 医生建议他住院观察，但他觉得没必要，所以决定不住院。
items.py: yī shēng jiàn yì tā zhù yuàn guān chá dàn tā jué de méi bì yào suǒ yǐ jué dìng bù zhù yuàn
items.en: The doctor suggested he stay in hospital for observation, but he felt it was unnecessary, so he decided not to be admitted.
items.why: 决定 introduces a decision, so 不. 没 cannot follow 决定.

items.q: 视频会议开始了十分钟，老板还___出现，大家只好先讨论。
items.zh: 视频会议开始了十分钟，老板还没出现，大家只好先讨论。
items.py: shì pín huì yì kāi shǐ le shí fēn zhōng lǎo bǎn hái méi chū xiàn dà jiā zhǐ hǎo xiān tǎo lùn
items.en: Ten minutes into the video meeting the boss still hadn't appeared, so everyone started discussing first.
items.why: 还没 reports that something expected has not happened by now. 还不出现 would sound like he refuses to appear.

items.q: 这段话太难了，就算再听一遍，我也___。
items.zh: 这段话太难了，就算再听一遍，我也听不懂。
items.py: zhè duàn huà tài nán le jiù suàn zài tīng yī biàn wǒ yě tīng bù dǒng
items.en: This passage is so hard that even if I listened once more, I still wouldn't understand.
items.why: A hypothetical "even if I listen again" is about ability: verb + 不 + result. 没听懂 only reports a past failure.

items.q: 对不起，我昨天___看懂你的短信。
items.zh: 对不起，我昨天没看懂你的短信。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ zuó tiān méi kàn dǒng nǐ de duǎn xìn
items.en: Sorry, I didn't understand your text message yesterday.
items.why: A result not reached on a past day is 没 + verb + result. 不看懂 is wrong.

items.q: 昨天我翻遍了包，也___找到我的充电器。
items.zh: 昨天我翻遍了包，也没找到我的充电器。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ fān biàn le bāo yě méi zhǎo dào wǒ de chōng diàn qì
items.en: Yesterday I searched my whole bag and still didn't find my charger.
items.why: 昨天 is a specific past search that did not reach its result: 没找到. 不找到 is not a pattern.

items.q: 手机屏幕裂了，现在什么都___清楚。
items.zh: 手机屏幕裂了，现在什么都看不清楚。
items.py: shǒu jī píng mù liè le xiàn zài shén me dōu kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The phone screen is cracked, so now I can't see anything clearly.
items.why: 现在 is about ability caused by the cracked screen: verb + 不 + result. 没看清楚 would report one past glance.

items.q: 这颗药太大了，我吞___下去。
items.zh: 这颗药太大了，我吞不下去。
items.py: zhè kē yào tài dà le wǒ tūn bu xià qù
items.en: This pill is so big that I can't swallow it.
items.why: 太大了 gives the reason for an inability, so 吞不下去. 没 would report a past attempt.

items.q: 我的手机还___充满电，再等十分钟。
items.zh: 我的手机还没充满电，再等十分钟。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī hái méi chōng mǎn diàn zài děng shí fēn zhōng
items.en: My phone hasn't finished charging yet; wait ten more minutes.
items.why: 还没 + verb + result says the result is not yet reached. 不充满 does not fit here.

items.q: 我腿疼得厉害，走___远，你们先去吧。
items.zh: 我腿疼得厉害，走不远，你们先去吧。
items.py: wǒ tuǐ téng de lì hai zǒu bù yuǎn nǐ men xiān qù ba
items.en: My leg hurts badly and I can't walk far; you go ahead.
items.why: The reason is a present inability, so verb + 不 + result. 走没远 is not said.

items.q: 我的邮件发出去了，但对方的回复我还___看到。
items.zh: 我的邮件发出去了，但对方的回复我还没看到。
items.py: wǒ de yóu jiàn fā chū qù le dàn duì fāng de huí fù wǒ hái méi kàn dào
items.en: My email has gone out, but I haven't seen the other side's reply yet.
items.why: 还没 + verb + result: the result has not been reached yet. 不看到 is wrong.

items.q: 上课的时候请___玩手机。
items.zh: 上课的时候请别玩手机。
items.py: shàng kè de shí hou qǐng bié wán shǒu jī
items.en: Please don't play on your phone during class.
items.why: A request not to do something takes 别 (or 不要). 没 is not an imperative, and 不用 means "no need".

items.q: 药我已经买好了，你___再去药店了。
items.zh: 药我已经买好了，你不用再去药店了。
items.py: yào wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo le nǐ bú yòng zài qù yào diàn le
items.en: I've already bought the medicine; you don't need to go to the pharmacy again.
items.why: The reason is that it is already done, so the point is "no need": 不用. 别 would be a prohibition.

items.q: 手机快没电了，你___再玩游戏了。
items.zh: 手机快没电了，你别再玩游戏了。
items.py: shǒu jī kuài méi diàn le nǐ bié zài wán yóu xì le
items.en: Your phone is almost dead; stop playing games.
items.why: This tells someone to stop doing something, and 别...了 is the stop-it pattern. 不用 would only say "no need".

items.q: 孩子睡着了，你___大声说话。
items.zh: 孩子睡着了，你别大声说话。
items.py: hái zi shuì zháo le nǐ bié dà shēng shuō huà
items.en: The child is asleep; don't speak loudly.
items.why: An order needs 别 or 不要. Bare 不 would only state that you do not speak loudly.

items.q: 他在开车，你___给他打电话。
items.zh: 他在开车，你别给他打电话。
items.py: tā zài kāi chē nǐ bié gěi tā dǎ diàn huà
items.en: He's driving; don't call him.
items.why: A prohibition takes 别. 没 reports the past and cannot be an order.

items.q: 医生说你的病已经好了，___再吃药了。
items.zh: 医生说你的病已经好了，不用再吃药了。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ de bìng yǐ jīng hǎo le bú yòng zài chī yào le
items.en: The doctor says you're better, so you don't need to take any more medicine.
items.why: Reporting that something is no longer needed is 不用...了. 别 would be an order and clash with the doctor having said you recovered.

items.q: 睡觉前___看手机，对眼睛不好，也会睡不着。
items.zh: 睡觉前别看手机，对眼睛不好，也会睡不着。
items.py: shuì jiào qián bié kàn shǒu jī duì yǎn jing bù hǎo yě huì shuì bù zháo
items.en: Don't look at your phone before bed; it's bad for your eyes and you won't be able to sleep.
items.why: Advice against doing something is 别 + verb. 不用 would say it is unnecessary, and 没 is not an imperative.

items.q: 你___哭了，医生说只是小手术。
items.zh: 你别哭了，医生说只是小手术。
items.py: nǐ bié kū le yī shēng shuō zhǐ shì xiǎo shǒu shù
items.en: Stop crying; the doctor says it's only a minor operation.
items.why: 别...了 tells someone to stop. 不用哭了 would sound like "there is no need to cry", not a comfort.

items.zh: 我昨天没吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: I didn't have breakfast yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes right before the verb it negates, after the time word and subject. The time word may sit before or after 我.

items.zh: 医生今天不在医院。
items.py: yī shēng jīn tiān bú zài yī yuàn
items.en: The doctor isn't at the hospital today.
items.why: 不在 + place is the standard negative of 在. The time word can come before or after the subject, but 不在 stays before the place.

items.zh: 睡觉前别看手机。
items.py: shuì jiào qián bié kàn shǒu jī
items.en: Don't look at your phone before bed.
items.why: 别 must sit right before the verb it forbids, and the time phrase may come before or after 别. 别 cannot go after 看.

items.zh: 这位医生的电话我没有。
items.py: zhè wèi yī shēng de diàn huà wǒ méi yǒu
items.en: I don't have this doctor's phone number.
items.why: 没有 negates 有 and sits right before or after its noun phrase in a topic-comment order. 不有 is never possible.

items.zh: 上课时请不要玩手机。
items.py: shàng kè shí qǐng bú yào wán shǒu jī
items.en: Please don't play on your phone during class.
items.why: 不要 goes right before the verb phrase it forbids. 上课时 may come before or after 请.

items.zh: 我昨天没带手机出门。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi dài shǒu jī chū mén
items.en: I didn't take my phone when I went out yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes right before 带 and no 了 appears. The time word may precede or follow 我, and 出门 may come before 没带手机 or after it.

items.zh: 他写的字我都看不懂。
items.py: tā xiě de zì wǒ dōu kàn bù dǒng
items.en: I can't read any of his handwriting.
items.why: 看不懂 keeps 不 between the verb and its result. 都 comes right before it. The topic phrase may come first or last.

items.zh: 他说明天不来公司。
items.py: tā shuō míng tiān bù lái gōng sī
items.en: He says he isn't coming to the office tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 is a plan, so 不 goes before 来, after the time word in the reported clause.

items.zh: 这家诊所周末没有医生。
items.py: zhè jiā zhěn suǒ zhōu mò méi yǒu yī shēng
items.en: This clinic has no doctor on weekends.
items.why: 没有 + noun for non-existence. The time word can come before or after the subject.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn
items.zh: 我昨天没去医院。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù yī yuàn
items.en: I didn't go to the hospital yesterday.
items.why: Negating a completed action swaps 了 for 没: 没去 with no 了.

items.src_py: wǒ néng shàng wǎng
items.zh: 我不能上网。
items.py: wǒ bù néng shàng wǎng
items.en: I can't get online.
items.why: The modal 能 is negated with 不. 没能 would mean "did not manage to", a different sentence.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le tā de huà
items.zh: 我听不懂他的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā de huà
items.en: I can't understand what he says.
items.why: "Cannot" is verb + 不 + result: 听不懂. 没听懂 would only say you did not understand.

items.src_py: tā zài chuáng shàng wán shǒu jī
items.zh: 别在床上玩手机。
items.py: bié zài chuáng shàng wán shǒu jī
items.en: Don't play on your phone in bed.
items.why: A prohibition is 别 + verb phrase. The 在 phrase stays after 别, before the verb.

items.src_py: wǒ yǒu xìn hào
items.zh: 我没有信号。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu xìn hào
items.en: I have no signal.
items.why: 有 is negated only with 没有. 不有 does not exist.

items.s: 我的手机不有电了。
items.s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bù yǒu diàn le
items.zh: 我的手机没有电了。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi yǒu diàn le
items.en: My phone has no battery left.
items.why: 有 is only ever negated with 没; 不有 does not exist.

items.s: 他昨天没去了医院。
items.s_py: tā zuó tiān méi qù le yī yuàn
items.zh: 他昨天没去医院。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi qù yī yuàn
items.en: He didn't go to the hospital yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so 了 cannot follow the verb.

items.s: 我已经三天没发烧了。
items.s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān tiān méi fā shāo le
items.zh: 我已经三天没发烧了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān tiān méi fā shāo le
items.en: I haven't had a fever for three days.
items.why: 没...了 with a length of time is correct: it says how long since something last happened. It does not negate a completed action.

items.s: 我从来不住过院。
items.s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù zhù guo yuàn
items.zh: 我从来没住过院。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi zhù guo yuàn
items.en: I have never been in hospital.
items.why: Verb + 过 is an experience up to now and is negated with 没. 不 cannot combine with 过.

items.s: 她没在打电话，她在发短信。
items.s_py: tā méi zài dǎ diàn huà tā zài fā duǎn xìn
items.zh: 她没在打电话，她在发短信。
items.py: tā méi zài dǎ diàn huà tā zài fā duǎn xìn
items.en: She isn't on the phone; she's texting.
items.why: The progressive 在 + verb is negated with 没, so 没在打电话 is correct.

items.s: 我没会修电脑。
items.s_py: wǒ méi huì xiū diàn nǎo
items.zh: 我不会修电脑。
items.py: wǒ bú huì xiū diàn nǎo
items.en: I don't know how to repair computers.
items.why: 会 is a modal verb and is negated with 不. 没会 is impossible.

items.s: 医生没想到他恢复得这么快。
items.s_py: yī shēng méi xiǎng dào tā huī fù de zhè me kuài
items.zh: 医生没想到他恢复得这么快。
items.py: yī shēng méi xiǎng dào tā huī fù de zhè me kuài
items.en: The doctor didn't expect him to recover so quickly.
items.why: 没想到 ("did not expect") is a fixed correct expression, not the modal 想 negated with 没.

items.s: 昨天的体检没贵，只要两百块。
items.s_py: zuó tiān de tǐ jiǎn méi guì zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài
items.zh: 昨天的体检不贵，只要两百块。
items.py: zuó tiān de tǐ jiǎn bú guì zhǐ yào liǎng bǎi kuài
items.en: Yesterday's check-up wasn't expensive; it was only two hundred yuan.
items.why: 贵 is an adjective, so it takes 不 even for yesterday. 没贵 is wrong.

items.s: 他昨天没在家，去医院了。
items.s_py: tā zuó tiān méi zài jiā qù yī yuàn le
items.zh: 他昨天没在家，去医院了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi zài jiā qù yī yuàn le
items.en: He wasn't at home yesterday; he went to the hospital.
items.why: 没在 + place is fine about the past: it reports he was not there. 不在家 would also be possible, so this is not an error.

items.s: 他没是我们的医生。
items.s_py: tā méi shì wǒ men de yī shēng
items.zh: 他不是我们的医生。
items.py: tā bú shì wǒ men de yī shēng
items.en: He isn't our doctor.
items.why: 是 is only ever negated with 不. 没是 does not exist.

items.s: 天还没黑，别开灯。
items.s_py: tiān hái méi hēi bié kāi dēng
items.zh: 天还没黑，别开灯。
items.py: tiān hái méi hēi bié kāi dēng
items.en: It isn't dark yet; don't turn on the light.
items.why: 还没 + adjective is correct for a change that has not happened yet, so 没黑 is right. 别 gives the order.

items.s: 我小时候没喜欢吃药。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou méi xǐ huan chī yào
items.zh: 我小时候不喜欢吃药。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù xǐ huan chī yào
items.en: I didn't like taking medicine when I was little.
items.why: 喜欢 is a state verb and takes 不 even for the past. 没喜欢 is wrong.

items.s: 你们没说话，宝宝在睡觉！
items.s_py: nǐ men méi shuō huà bǎo bao zài shuì jiào
items.zh: 你们别说话，宝宝在睡觉！
items.py: nǐ men bié shuō huà bǎo bao zài shuì jiào
items.en: Don't talk; the baby is sleeping!
items.why: An order needs 别 or 不要. 没说话 only reports that you did not talk.

items.s: 你不用担心，这只是小感冒。
items.s_py: nǐ bú yòng dān xīn zhè zhǐ shì xiǎo gǎn mào
items.zh: 你不用担心，这只是小感冒。
items.py: nǐ bú yòng dān xīn zhè zhǐ shì xiǎo gǎn mào
items.en: You needn't worry; it's only a minor cold.
items.why: 不用 + verb means "no need to", which fits reassurance, so this is correct.

items.s: 请没在医院里抽烟。
items.s_py: qǐng méi zài yī yuàn lǐ chōu yān
items.zh: 请不要在医院里抽烟。
items.py: qǐng bú yào zài yī yuàn lǐ chōu yān
items.en: Please don't smoke in the hospital.
items.why: 请 introduces a request, so the prohibition needs 不要 or 别. 没 reports a past fact and cannot follow 请.

items.s: 虽然医生说我可以出院了，但我还没完全好，所以不想回去上班。
items.s_py: suī rán yī shēng shuō wǒ kě yǐ chū yuàn le dàn wǒ hái méi wán quán hǎo suǒ yǐ bù xiǎng huí qù shàng bān
items.zh: 虽然医生说我可以出院了，但我还没完全好，所以不想回去上班。
items.py: suī rán yī shēng shuō wǒ kě yǐ chū yuàn le dàn wǒ hái méi wán quán hǎo suǒ yǐ bù xiǎng huí qù shàng bān
items.en: Although the doctor says I can leave the hospital, I'm not fully better yet, so I don't want to go back to work.
items.why: 还没 marks a change not yet complete, and 不想 negates the modal 想. Each negator is right in its own clause.

items.s: 我听了三遍，还是没听得懂医生说的话。
items.s_py: wǒ tīng le sān biàn hái shi méi tīng de dǒng yī shēng shuō de huà
items.zh: 我听了三遍，还是听不懂医生说的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng le sān biàn hái shi tīng bù dǒng yī shēng shuō de huà
items.en: I listened three times and still can't understand what the doctor says.
items.why: 没 cannot combine with the potential form 得. Say 没听懂 or 听不懂; the potential negative is 听不懂.

items.s: 我没听清楚他说什么。
items.s_py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chu tā shuō shén me
items.zh: 我没听清楚他说什么。
items.py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chu tā shuō shén me
items.en: I didn't catch what he said.
items.why: 没 + verb + result is correct for a result not reached. 不听清楚 would be wrong.

items.s: 虽然医生提醒过他，他昨天还是没带了医保卡。
items.s_py: suī rán yī shēng tí xǐng guo tā tā zuó tiān hái shi méi dài le yī bǎo kǎ
items.zh: 虽然医生提醒过他，他昨天还是没带医保卡。
items.py: suī rán yī shēng tí xǐng guo tā tā zuó tiān hái shi méi dài yī bǎo kǎ
items.en: Although the doctor reminded him, he still didn't bring his insurance card yesterday.
items.why: 没 plus the verb is enough; 了 cannot follow 带 after 没.

items.q: 我答应过他要去看比赛，可是临时有事，结果___去成。
items.zh: 我答应过他要去看比赛，可是临时有事，结果没去成。
items.py: wǒ dā ying guo tā yào qù kàn bǐ sài kě shì lín shí yǒu shì jié guǒ méi qù chéng
items.en: I promised him I'd go to the match, but something came up and in the end I didn't get to go.
items.why: 结果 reports what actually turned out, so 没去成 (did not manage to go). 不去成 is not a form.

items.q: 昨天下大雨，我___想出去跑步。
items.zh: 昨天下大雨，我不想出去跑步。
items.py: zuó tiān xià dà yǔ wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù pǎo bù
items.en: It rained hard yesterday and I didn't feel like going out for a run.
items.why: 想 (feel like) is a wish, so it takes 不 even for yesterday. 没 would deny an event rather than a wish.

items.zh: 这家店春节期间不开门。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn chūn jié qī jiān bù kāi mén
items.en: This shop is not open during Spring Festival.
items.why: A regular closing is a plan or habit, so 不 goes before 开门. 不 stays after the time phrase.

items.zh: 比赛还没开始。
items.py: bǐ sài hái méi kāi shǐ
items.en: The match hasn't started yet.
items.why: 还 comes before 没: 还没 + verb means 'not yet'. 没还 is not possible.

items.q: 这个球太高了，我接___到。
items.zh: 这个球太高了，我接不到。
items.py: zhè ge qiú tài gāo le wǒ jiē bù dào
items.en: This ball is too high; I can't catch it.
items.why: 'Cannot' with a result complement puts 不 between the verb and the result: 接不到. 接没到 is not a form.

items.q: 我平时___去健身房，只有周末才去。
items.zh: 我平时不去健身房，只有周末才去。
items.py: wǒ píng shí bù qù jiàn shēn fáng zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò cái qù
items.en: I don't usually go to the gym; I only go on weekends.
items.why: 平时 plus 只有周末才去 describes a habit, and a habit is negated with 不. 没 would report one occasion that did not happen.

items.q: 他还___起床呢，比赛十点才开始。
items.zh: 他还没起床呢，比赛十点才开始。
items.py: tā hái méi qǐ chuáng ne bǐ sài shí diǎn cái kāi shǐ
items.en: He hasn't got up yet; the match only starts at ten.
items.why: 还...呢 means 'not yet', which is 没 + verb. 不起床 would say he refuses to get up.

items.q: 那场比赛我们输得很惨，一个球也没进___。
items.zh: 那场比赛我们输得很惨，一个球也没进。
items.py: nà chǎng bǐ sài wǒ men shū de hěn cǎn yī ge qiú yě méi jìn
items.en: We lost that match badly; we didn't score a single goal.
items.why: 没进 reports a goal that never happened, so there is no 了 after it.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le cái pàn de huà
items.zh: 我没听懂裁判的话。
items.py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng cái pàn de huà
items.en: I didn't understand what the referee said.
items.why: A result that was not reached is 没 + verb + result, and 了 is dropped. 不听懂 is not a form.

items.q: 孩子们，___在冰上跑，很危险！
items.zh: 孩子们，别在冰上跑，很危险！
items.py: hái zi men bié zài bīng shàng pǎo hěn wēi xiǎn
items.en: Children, don't run on the ice; it's dangerous!
items.why: Prohibition is 别 + verb. 不用 would only say 'no need to run' and 没 cannot give an order.

items.q: 小时候我___喜欢游泳，长大后才爱上它。
items.zh: 小时候我不喜欢游泳，长大后才爱上它。
items.py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ bù xǐ huan yóu yǒng zhǎng dà hòu cái ài shàng tā
items.en: I didn't like swimming as a child; I only came to love it when I grew up.
items.why: 喜欢 is a state verb and is negated with 不 whatever the time. 没喜欢 is not said.

items.zh: 我不会打网球。
items.py: wǒ bù huì dǎ wǎng qiú
items.en: I can't play tennis.
items.why: 不 attaches to the modal 会 in front of the main verb: 不会打. 会不打 would change the meaning and 打不会 is not a form.

items.s: 我没会滑雪。
items.zh: 我不会滑雪。
items.py: wǒ bù huì huá xuě
items.en: I can't ski.
items.why: 会 is a modal verb and is negated with 不. 没会 is never possible.
items.s_py: wǒ méi huì huá xuě

items.s: 我昨天不去看球赛。
items.zh: 我昨天没去看球赛。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù kàn qiú sài
items.en: I didn't go to the match yesterday.
items.why: 昨天 makes it a past event that did not happen, so 没去. 不去 looks forward or expresses refusal.
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān bù qù kàn qiú sài

items.q: 不管大家怎么劝，他就是___参加今年的龙舟比赛。
items.zh: 不管大家怎么劝，他就是不参加今年的龙舟比赛。
items.py: bù guǎn dà jiā zěn me quàn tā jiù shì bù cān jiā jīn nián de lóng zhōu bǐ sài
items.en: No matter how everyone urges him, he simply refuses to take part in this year's dragon boat race.
items.why: 就是 after 不管...劝 expresses stubborn refusal, and refusal is 不. 别 is an order to someone else and cannot have 他 as its subject.

items.q: 我以前___知道这个节日的来历。
items.zh: 我以前不知道这个节日的来历。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián bù zhī dào zhè ge jié rì de lái lì
items.en: I didn't know the origin of this festival before.
items.why: 知道 is a state verb, so it takes 不 even for the past: 以前不知道. 没知道 is not a normal phrase.

items.zh: 我不喜欢爬山。
items.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan pá shān
items.en: I don't like hiking.
items.why: 喜欢 is a state verb, so 不 goes directly before it: 不喜欢. 喜欢不 is not a form.

items.q: 我找了半天，也___找到我的球拍，可能落在比赛场地了。
items.zh: 我找了半天，也没找到我的球拍，可能落在比赛场地了。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào wǒ de qiú pāi kě néng là zài bǐ sài chǎng dì le
items.en: I searched for ages and still didn't find my racket; I may have left it at the match venue.
items.why: 找了半天 is a past search that did not reach its result: 没找到. 不找到 is not a statement; 找不到 would say 'can't find'.

items.s: 过完年，我们没有时间踢球了。
items.zh: 过完年，我们没有时间踢球了。
items.py: guò wán nián wǒ men méi yǒu shí jiān tī qiú le
items.en: After the New Year we won't have time to play football any more.
items.why: 没有...了 means 'no longer have'. The 了 marks a change of situation, not a completed action, so it is correct with 没有.

items.q: 比赛的时候，你___说话！
items.zh: 比赛的时候，你别说话！
items.py: bǐ sài de shí hou nǐ bié shuō huà
items.en: Don't talk during the match!
items.why: An order needs 别 or 不要 before the verb. 你不说话 only states that you are not talking, and 没 looks back.

items.q: 我已经买好票了，你___买了。
items.zh: 我已经买好票了，你不用买了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo piào le nǐ bù yòng mǎi le
items.en: I've already bought the tickets; you don't need to buy any.
items.why: 不用 means 'there is no need to'. 没有 and 不会 cannot be followed by a bare verb to say that.

items.q: 刚才进球的时候，我___在看比赛，所以没看到。
items.zh: 刚才进球的时候，我没在看比赛，所以没看到。
items.py: gāng cái jìn qiú de shí hou wǒ méi zài kàn bǐ sài suǒ yǐ méi kàn dào
items.en: I wasn't watching the match when the goal was scored, so I didn't see it.
items.why: 没在 + verb denies that an action was in progress at that past moment, matching 没看到 after it. 不在看 is not the usual negation of a progressive and does not fit a specific moment.

items.q: 因为下大雨，今年的龙舟比赛没有举行___，大家都很失望。
items.zh: 因为下大雨，今年的龙舟比赛没有举行，大家都很失望。
items.py: yīn wèi xià dà yǔ jīn nián de lóng zhōu bǐ sài méi yǒu jǔ xíng dà jiā dōu hěn shī wàng
items.en: Because of heavy rain, this year's dragon boat race wasn't held, and everyone was disappointed.
items.why: 没有举行 negates a completed event, so 了 is dropped. The comma after it starts a new clause with its own meaning.

items.q: 弟弟今天早上没去游泳___。
items.zh: 弟弟今天早上没去游泳。
items.py: dì di jīn tiān zǎo shang méi qù yóu yǒng
items.en: My younger brother didn't go swimming this morning.
items.why: A negated past action takes 没 without 了. Adding 了 would wrongly mix 'it happened' with 'it did not happen'.

items.zh: 我没看懂这场比赛的规则。
items.py: wǒ méi kàn dǒng zhè chǎng bǐ sài de guī zé
items.en: I didn't understand the rules of this match.
items.why: 没 goes before the verb + result 看懂 to say the result was not reached. 看没懂 is not possible.

items.q: 今天___比赛，大家都在家休息。
items.zh: 今天没有比赛，大家都在家休息。
items.py: jīn tiān méi yǒu bǐ sài dà jiā dōu zài jiā xiū xi
items.en: There is no match today; everyone is resting at home.
items.why: 有 is negated only with 没: 没有比赛. 不有 does not exist, and 不是比赛 would not mean 'there is none'.

items.q: 明天我们在家看比赛，你___早起，睡个懒觉吧。
items.zh: 明天我们在家看比赛，你不用早起，睡个懒觉吧。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ men zài jiā kàn bǐ sài nǐ bù yòng zǎo qǐ shuì ge lǎn jiào ba
items.en: We're watching the match at home tomorrow; you don't need to get up early, so sleep in.
items.why: The point is that early rising is unnecessary, which is 不用. 没 looks back at the past and 不是 negates a noun or 是.

items.zh: 你别在这里放鞭炮。
items.py: nǐ bié zài zhè lǐ fàng biān pào
items.en: Don't set off firecrackers here.
items.why: 别 comes before the whole verb phrase: 别 + 在这里 + 放鞭炮. 放鞭炮别 is not a form.

items.zh: 他腿受伤了，所以不能参加比赛。
items.py: tā tuǐ shòu shāng le suǒ yǐ bù néng cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: His leg is injured, so he can't take part in the match.
items.why: 不 goes before the modal 能, not before 参加. 所以 starts the result clause.

items.src_py: tā mǎi le nà zhāng qiú piào
items.zh: 他没买那张球票。
items.py: tā méi mǎi nà zhāng qiú piào
items.en: He didn't buy that match ticket.
items.why: The negative of 买了 is 没买, with 了 removed. 没买了 is the classic error.

items.q: 我___会滑冰，只会滑雪。
items.zh: 我不会滑冰，只会滑雪。
items.py: wǒ bù huì huá bīng zhǐ huì huá xuě
items.en: I can't skate; I can only ski.
items.why: 会 is a modal verb and 不 goes in front of it. 没会 is not possible.

items.s: 去年的球票没贵。
items.zh: 去年的球票不贵。
items.py: qù nián de qiú piào bù guì
items.en: Last year's match tickets weren't expensive.
items.why: 贵 is an adjective, so it takes 不 even about last year. 没贵 is not a phrase.
items.s_py: qù nián de qiú piào méi guì

items.q: 对不起，我昨天___给你打电话。
items.zh: 对不起，我昨天没给你打电话。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ zuó tiān méi gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: Sorry, I didn't call you yesterday.
items.why: 昨天 plus 打电话 is a specific action that did not occur: 没. 不打 would be a refusal to call.

items.q: 我家附近___公园，我只能在家锻炼。
items.zh: 我家附近没有公园，我只能在家锻炼。
items.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu gōng yuán wǒ zhǐ néng zài jiā duàn liàn
items.en: There is no park near my home, so I can only exercise at home.
items.why: Non-existence is 没有. 不有 is never said, and 不是公园 would claim that something nearby is not a park.

items.q: 我___觉得今年的灯会比去年热闹。
items.zh: 我不觉得今年的灯会比去年热闹。
items.py: wǒ bù jué de jīn nián de dēng huì bǐ qù nián rè nao
items.en: I don't think this year's lantern festival is livelier than last year's.
items.why: 觉得 gives an opinion and takes 不. 没 cannot negate an opinion, and 别 is only for commands.

items.q: 圣诞节那天我们___去商场，一直在家包饺子。
items.zh: 圣诞节那天我们没去商场，一直在家包饺子。
items.py: shèng dàn jié nà tiān wǒ men méi qù shāng chǎng yī zhí zài jiā bāo jiǎo zi
items.en: On Christmas Day we didn't go to the mall; we stayed home making dumplings.
items.why: 一直在家 reports what actually happened that day, so the negative is 没. 不去 would be a plan or refusal.

items.q: 这只是朋友间的小比赛，你___太紧张，放松一点。
items.zh: 这只是朋友间的小比赛，你不要太紧张，放松一点。
items.py: zhè zhǐ shì péng you jiān de xiǎo bǐ sài nǐ bú yào tài jǐn zhāng fàng sōng yī diǎn
items.en: This is only a small match between friends; don't be too nervous, relax a bit.
items.why: 不要 + verb is a command, 'don't be so nervous'. 没 and 不是 cannot start a command.

items.q: 今年的龙舟比赛，我们队___有足够的人，只好放弃了。
items.zh: 今年的龙舟比赛，我们队没有足够的人，只好放弃了。
items.py: jīn nián de lóng zhōu bǐ sài wǒ men duì méi yǒu zú gòu de rén zhǐ hǎo fàng qì le
items.en: Our team doesn't have enough people for this year's dragon boat race, so we have to give up.
items.why: 没有足够的人 negates 有 with 没. 不有 does not exist, even in a sentence about a decision or a plan.

items.q: 这些月饼太多了，我们吃___完。
items.zh: 这些月饼太多了，我们吃不完。
items.py: zhè xiē yuè bing tài duō le wǒ men chī bù wán
items.en: There are too many mooncakes; we can't finish them.
items.why: Cannot manage to finish = 吃不完, with 不 between verb and result. 吃没完 is not said.

items.s: 他昨天没在家，去看龙舟比赛了。
items.zh: 他昨天没在家，去看龙舟比赛了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi zài jiā qù kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài le
items.en: He wasn't at home yesterday; he went to watch the dragon boat race.
items.why: 没在 + place is accepted, especially about the past. The 了 belongs to the second clause 去看...了, a completed action, not to the negated one.

items.zh: 我从来没参加过马拉松。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng
items.en: I have never taken part in a marathon.
items.why: 从来没 + verb + 过 is the standard pattern for an experience never had. 没 comes after 从来, and 过 must stay on the verb.

items.s: 春节的时候，爷爷从来不玩手机。
items.zh: 春节的时候，爷爷从来不玩手机。
items.py: chūn jié de shí hou yé ye cóng lái bù wán shǒu jī
items.en: At Spring Festival Grandpa never plays with his phone.
items.why: 从来不 + verb states a standing habit. 不 is correct here, and 没 would need 过: 从来没玩过.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù tī zú qiú le
items.zh: 我昨天没去踢足球。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù tī zú qiú
items.en: I didn't go to play football yesterday.
items.why: Negating a completed action: put 没 before the verb and drop 了. 不去 would mean a refusal or a plan.

items.q: 明年夏天我___有时间去参加马拉松，要出差。
items.zh: 明年夏天我没有时间去参加马拉松，要出差。
items.py: míng nián xià tiān wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān qù cān jiā mǎ lā sōng yào chū chāi
items.en: Next summer I won't have time to run in the marathon; I have a business trip.
items.why: 有 is negated with 没 in the future too: 没有时间. 不有 is impossible, however far ahead the time word points.

items.q: 我昨天没踢足球___。
items.zh: 我昨天没踢足球。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi tī zú qiú
items.en: I didn't play football yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so the completion 了 has nothing to mark and must be left out.

items.s: 你没应该在比赛前喝酒。
items.zh: 你不应该在比赛前喝酒。
items.py: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài bǐ sài qián hē jiǔ
items.en: You shouldn't drink alcohol before a match.
items.why: 应该 is a modal verb and takes 不. 没应该 does not exist.
items.s_py: nǐ méi yīng gāi zài bǐ sài qián hē jiǔ

items.q: 你昨天怎么___来看球赛？我们等了你很久。
items.zh: 你昨天怎么没来看球赛？我们等了你很久。
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān zěn me méi lái kàn qiú sài wǒ men děng le nǐ hěn jiǔ
items.en: Why didn't you come to the match yesterday? We waited a long time for you.
items.why: The question is about something that did not happen yesterday, so 没来. 怎么不来 asks why someone is not coming at all, a habit or plan.

items.s: 明天我不有比赛。
items.zh: 明天我没有比赛。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ méi yǒu bǐ sài
items.en: I don't have a match tomorrow.
items.why: 有 is only ever negated with 没, even for tomorrow; 不有 does not exist.
items.s_py: míng tiān wǒ bù yǒu bǐ sài

items.q: 我们等了一个小时，他还是___来。
items.zh: 我们等了一个小时，他还是没来。
items.py: wǒ men děng le yī gè xiǎo shí tā hái shi méi lái
items.en: We waited an hour and he still didn't come.
items.why: The sentence reports what did not happen after an hour of waiting: 没来. 不来 would say he refuses to come.

items.q: 他没买月饼，买___两盒茶叶。
items.zh: 他没买月饼，买了两盒茶叶。
items.py: tā méi mǎi yuè bing mǎi le liǎng hé chá yè
items.en: He didn't buy mooncakes; he bought two boxes of tea instead.
items.why: Only the 没 half drops 了. The positive half is a completed action with a counted object, so 了 goes right after the verb.

items.s: 照片太小了，我看没清楚。
items.zh: 照片太小了，我看不清楚。
items.py: zhào piàn tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
items.en: The photo is too small; I can't see it clearly.
items.why: 'Cannot' with a complement is verb + 不 + result: 看不清楚. 没 cannot sit between a verb and its result.
items.s_py: zhào piàn tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn méi qīng chu

items.q: 这个粽子我还___吃，你先别拿走。
items.zh: 这个粽子我还没吃，你先别拿走。
items.py: zhè ge zòng zi wǒ hái méi chī nǐ xiān bié ná zǒu
items.en: I haven't eaten this zongzi yet; don't take it away yet.
items.why: 还没 + verb means 'not yet', the action has not happened up to now. 还不吃 would suggest a refusal to eat.

items.q: 这场比赛的票太贵了，我买___起。
items.zh: 这场比赛的票太贵了，我买不起。
items.py: zhè chǎng bǐ sài de piào tài guì le wǒ mǎi bù qǐ
items.en: The tickets for this match are too expensive; I can't afford them.
items.why: 买不起 is the potential form 'cannot afford', with 不 between verb and complement. 买没起 does not exist.

items.q: 声音太小了，我听___清楚裁判说什么。
items.zh: 声音太小了，我听不清楚裁判说什么。
items.py: shēng yīn tài xiǎo le wǒ tīng bù qīng chu cái pàn shuō shén me
items.en: The sound is too low; I can't hear what the referee is saying.
items.why: 听不清楚 means 'cannot hear clearly', with 不 inside the verb-complement. 听没清楚 is not a form.

items.s: 昨天我请他去爬山，他不去。
items.zh: 昨天我请他去爬山，他不去。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ qǐng tā qù pá shān tā bù qù
items.en: I invited him to go hiking yesterday, but he wouldn't go.
items.why: 不 about a past moment expresses refusal at that time, which is the meaning here. 没去 would only report that he did not go.

items.q: 他___是我们的篮球教练，他是体育老师。
items.zh: 他不是我们的篮球教练，他是体育老师。
items.py: tā bù shì wǒ men de lán qiú jiào liàn tā shì tǐ yù lǎo shī
items.en: He isn't our basketball coach; he's the PE teacher.
items.why: 是 is only ever negated with 不; 没是 does not exist.

items.zh: 今天没有比赛。
