items.py: jīn tiān méi yǒu bǐ sài
items.en: There's no match today.
items.why: 没有 negates the noun 比赛, so it stands right before it, with the time word 今天 in front. 不有 would be wrong, as 有 only takes 没.

items.q: 我___坐过龙舟，听说很刺激。
items.zh: 我没坐过龙舟，听说很刺激。
items.py: wǒ méi zuò guo lóng zhōu tīng shuō hěn cì jī
items.en: I have never ridden in a dragon boat; I hear it's exciting.
items.why: 坐过 means 'have experienced', and its negative is always 没. 不坐过 is not possible.

items.q: 今年的春节一点儿也___热闹，街上几乎没有人。
items.zh: 今年的春节一点儿也不热闹，街上几乎没有人。
items.py: jīn nián de chūn jié yī diǎn r yě bù rè nao jiē shàng jī hū méi yǒu rén
items.en: This year's Spring Festival isn't lively at all; there's hardly anyone in the street.
items.why: 热闹 is an adjective, so 一点儿也不热闹. 没热闹 is not a possible phrase.

items.q: 我爱好摄影很多年了，可是还___拍过一张让自己满意的照片。
items.zh: 我爱好摄影很多年了，可是还没拍过一张让自己满意的照片。
items.py: wǒ ài hào shè yǐng hěn duō nián le kě shì hái méi pāi guo yī zhāng ràng zì jǐ mǎn yì de zhào piàn
items.en: I've loved photography for many years, but I still haven't taken one photo I'm happy with.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 过 says that up to now it has never happened. 还不拍过 is ungrammatical.

items.q: 今天的比赛___难，我们很容易就赢了。
items.zh: 今天的比赛不难，我们很容易就赢了。
items.py: jīn tiān de bǐ sài bù nán wǒ men hěn róng yì jiù yíng le
items.en: Today's match wasn't hard; we won easily.
items.why: 难 is an adjective describing a quality, so it takes 不 even when the match is already over. 没 is for events, not qualities.

items.s: 他昨天没参加比赛了。
items.zh: 他昨天没参加比赛。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: He didn't take part in the match yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so the completion 了 must be dropped.
items.s_py: tā zuó tiān méi cān jiā bǐ sài le

items.q: 我的朋友都___愿意陪我去看龙舟比赛，他们说人太多。
items.zh: 我的朋友都不愿意陪我去看龙舟比赛，他们说人太多。
items.py: wǒ de péng you dōu bù yuàn yì péi wǒ qù kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài tā men shuō rén tài duō
items.en: None of my friends is willing to come with me to the dragon boat race; they say it is too crowded.
items.why: 愿意 is a modal of willingness and takes 不. 没愿意 is not used.

items.q: 你已经踢了三个小时了，___再踢了，休息一下吧。
items.zh: 你已经踢了三个小时了，别再踢了，休息一下吧。
items.py: nǐ yǐ jīng tī le sān ge xiǎo shí le bié zài tī le xiū xi yī xià ba
items.en: You've already played for three hours; stop playing and take a break.
items.why: 别...了 means 'stop doing it'. 没 and 不是 cannot be followed by 再 to say that.

items.zh: 明天我不去爬山。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ bù qù pá shān
items.en: I'm not going hiking tomorrow.
items.why: 不 goes right before the verb 去. The time word 明天 may come before or after 我, but 不 may not move.

items.q: 她不但___会骑马，而且连马都怕。
items.zh: 她不但不会骑马，而且连马都怕。
items.py: tā bù dàn bù huì qí mǎ ér qiě lián mǎ dōu pà
items.en: She not only can't ride a horse; she's even afraid of horses.
items.why: 不但不会 negates the modal 会 with 不. 没会 is never possible, in any construction.

items.s: 昨天不冷，我们去爬山了。
items.zh: 昨天不冷，我们去爬山了。
items.py: zuó tiān bù lěng wǒ men qù pá shān le
items.en: It wasn't cold yesterday, so we went hiking.
items.why: 冷 is an adjective, so it takes 不 even with 昨天. 没冷 would be the error.

items.s: 我没想到他会赢得这么轻松。
items.zh: 我没想到他会赢得这么轻松。
items.py: wǒ méi xiǎng dào tā huì yíng de zhè me qīng sōng
items.en: I didn't expect him to win so easily.
items.why: 没想到 is a fixed expression for 'didn't expect' (想到 reaches a result), so 没 is correct here although 想 alone is a modal that takes 不.

items.q: 我怎么说，弟弟就是___关电视。
items.zh: 我怎么说，弟弟就是不关电视。
items.py: wǒ zěn me shuō dì di jiù shì bù guān diàn shì
items.en: However I tell him, my younger brother simply refuses to turn off the TV.
items.why: 就是 + 不 shows stubborn refusal, which is 不. 没关 would only report that the TV was not turned off.

items.q: 明天下雨，我们___去爬山。
items.zh: 明天下雨，我们不去爬山。
items.py: míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ men bù qù pá shān
items.en: It's going to rain tomorrow, so we won't go hiking.
items.why: 明天 is in the future, and a plan that will not happen is negated with 不. 没 only looks back at something that did not happen.

items.s: 你不用等我，先去踢球吧。
items.zh: 你不用等我，先去踢球吧。
items.py: nǐ bù yòng děng wǒ xiān qù tī qiú ba
items.en: You don't need to wait for me; go and play football first.
items.why: 不用 means 'no need to'. It is correct here, since the sentence offers permission and is not a prohibition.

items.q: 你的身体还没恢复，医生说你现在___应该参加长跑比赛。
items.zh: 你的身体还没恢复，医生说你现在不应该参加长跑比赛。
items.py: nǐ de shēn tǐ hái méi huī fù yī shēng shuō nǐ xiàn zài bù yīng gāi cān jiā cháng pǎo bǐ sài
items.en: You haven't recovered yet; the doctor says you shouldn't take part in the long-distance race now.
items.why: 应该 is a modal and takes 不: 不应该 + verb. 没应该 and 别应该 are both impossible.

items.q: 教练问我们周末去不去踢球，我说我___去，要复习。
items.zh: 教练问我们周末去不去踢球，我说我不去，要复习。
items.py: jiào liàn wèn wǒ men zhōu mò qù bu qù tī qiú wǒ shuō wǒ bù qù yào fù xí
items.en: The coach asked whether we'd go play football at the weekend; I said I'm not going because I have to revise.
items.why: The weekend is still ahead, so a decision not to go is 不去. 没去 would say that it did not happen.

items.q: 你有___有兴趣参加周末的羽毛球比赛？
items.zh: 你有没有兴趣参加周末的羽毛球比赛？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xìng qù cān jiā zhōu mò de yǔ máo qiú bǐ sài
items.en: Are you interested in joining the badminton match this weekend?
items.why: The A-not-A question of 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is never said.

items.q: 老师说比赛的时候___可以用手机。
items.zh: 老师说比赛的时候不可以用手机。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō bǐ sài de shí hou bù kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī
items.en: The teacher said we may not use our phones during the match.
items.why: 可以 (permission) is negated with 不. Reported speech does not change that: 没可以 is not possible.

items.src_py: wǒ men míng tiān yǒu bǐ sài
items.zh: 我们明天没有比赛。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān méi yǒu bǐ sài
items.en: We don't have a match tomorrow.
items.why: 有 becomes 没有 in every tense, even for tomorrow. 不有 does not exist.

items.q: 他昨天跑步跑得太累了，到现在还___睡醒。
items.zh: 他昨天跑步跑得太累了，到现在还没睡醒。
items.py: tā zuó tiān pǎo bù pǎo de tài lèi le dào xiàn zài hái méi shuì xǐng
items.en: He got too tired running yesterday and still hasn't woken up.
items.why: 还没睡醒 says the result (waking up) has not been reached yet, so 没 goes before the verb. 还不睡醒 is not a normal phrase.

items.q: 我从来___去过滑雪场。
items.zh: 我从来没去过滑雪场。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo huá xuě chǎng
items.en: I have never been to a ski resort.
items.why: 去过 is an experience, and its negative is 没去过. 不去过 is impossible because 过 never follows 不.

items.s: 他说得太快了，我听不懂。
items.zh: 他说得太快了，我听不懂。
items.py: tā shuō de tài kuài le wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand.
items.why: 听不懂 is the potential form 'cannot understand', with 不 between verb and result. It is correct and different from 没听懂.

items.q: 春节的北京很冷，上海___太冷。
items.zh: 春节的北京很冷，上海不太冷。
items.py: chūn jié de běi jīng hěn lěng shàng hǎi bù tài lěng
items.en: Beijing is cold at Spring Festival, but Shanghai isn't too cold.
items.why: 冷 is an adjective, so the negative is 不 (不太冷). 没 would suggest it had not yet turned cold.

items.src_py: nǐ kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ fàng yān huā
items.zh: 你不可以在这里放烟花。
items.py: nǐ bù kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ fàng yān huā
items.en: You may not set off fireworks here.
items.why: 可以 is a modal, so it is negated with 不 placed directly before it: 不可以. The place phrase may come before or after 不可以, but 没可以 is not possible.

items.q: 你找到你的球鞋了吗？——我___找到。
items.zh: 你找到你的球鞋了吗？——我没找到。
items.py: nǐ zhǎo dào nǐ de qiú xié le ma wǒ méi zhǎo dào
items.en: Did you find your sneakers? — No, I didn't find them.
items.why: The question asks whether the result was reached and the answer says it was not, so 没 comes before the verb: 没找到. 不找到 is not possible.

items.q: 过年的时候我们___要去亲戚家，想在家休息。
items.zh: 过年的时候我们不要去亲戚家，想在家休息。
items.py: guò nián de shí hou wǒ men bù yào qù qīn qi jiā xiǎng zài jiā xiū xi
items.en: At New Year we don't want to visit relatives; we'd rather rest at home.
items.why: 要 here means 'want to', a modal, so the negative is 不要 (don't want). 没要去 is not said.

items.s: 老师的话我不听懂。
items.zh: 老师的话我没听懂。
items.py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
items.why: A result that was not reached is 没 + verb + result. 不听懂 is not a form; 'can't understand' would be 听不懂.
items.s_py: lǎo shī de huà wǒ bù tīng dǒng

items.s: 我们好久没一起踢球了。
items.zh: 我们好久没一起踢球了。
items.py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi yī qǐ tī qiú le
items.en: We haven't played football together for a long time.
items.why: 好久没...了 is a fixed pattern for the time since something last happened. It does not negate a completed action, so the final 了 is correct.

items.s: 我不参加过马拉松。
items.zh: 我没参加过马拉松。
items.py: wǒ méi cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng
items.en: I have never taken part in a marathon.
items.why: Verb + 过 is an experience up to now, so its negative is 没. 不参加过 is not possible.
items.s_py: wǒ bù cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng

items.q: 我怕水，所以从来___下河游泳。
items.zh: 我怕水，所以从来不下河游泳。
items.py: wǒ pà shuǐ suǒ yǐ cóng lái bù xià hé yóu yǒng
items.en: I'm afraid of water, so I never go swimming in the river.
items.why: 从来 + verb without 过 states a standing habit, which takes 不. 从来没 would need 过 to show an experience never had (从来没下过河).

items.q: 上个月我们没组织___郊游，大家都太忙了。
items.zh: 上个月我们没组织郊游，大家都太忙了。
items.py: shàng ge yuè wǒ men méi zǔ zhī jiāo yóu dà jiā dōu tài máng le
items.en: We didn't organize an outing last month; everyone was too busy.
items.why: 没组织郊游 has no 了, even though the time is clearly past. The 了 later in the sentence belongs to 太忙了, not to the negated verb.

items.s: 明年春节我没回家。
items.zh: 明年春节我不回家。
items.py: míng nián chūn jié wǒ bù huí jiā
items.en: I'm not going home next Spring Festival.
items.why: 明年 is in the future, and a plan not to do something is 不. 没 cannot refer to next year.
items.s_py: míng nián chūn jié wǒ méi huí jiā

items.q: 我没带___球拍，今天不能打球。
items.zh: 我没带球拍，今天不能打球。
items.py: wǒ méi dài qiú pāi jīn tiān bù néng dǎ qiú
items.en: I didn't bring my racket, so I can't play today.
items.why: 带球拍 is negated by 没, and 了 is dropped. 没带了球拍 is the classic error.

items.q: 这位运动员很有名，可是我以前___认识他。
items.zh: 这位运动员很有名，可是我以前不认识他。
items.py: zhè wèi yùn dòng yuán hěn yǒu míng kě shì wǒ yǐ qián bù rèn shi tā
items.en: This athlete is famous, but I didn't know him before.
items.why: 认识 is a state verb: it takes 不 even when 以前 puts it in the past.

items.s: 周末你有不有空去爬山？
items.zh: 周末你有没有空去爬山？
items.py: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kòng qù pá shān
items.en: Are you free to go hiking at the weekend?
items.why: The A-not-A form of 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is never said.
items.s_py: zhōu mò nǐ yǒu bu yǒu kòng qù pá shān

items.q: 我是素食者，所以平时___吃肉。
items.zh: 我是素食者，所以平时不吃肉。
items.py: wǒ shì sù shí zhě suǒ yǐ píng shí bù chī ròu
items.en: I'm a vegetarian, so I don't usually eat meat.
items.why: 平时 and the reason 素食者 show a standing habit, so 不. 没吃肉 would only say one meal had no meat.

items.q: 爷爷一向___放鞭炮，他说太吵，对耳朵不好。
items.zh: 爷爷一向不放鞭炮，他说太吵，对耳朵不好。
items.py: yé ye yí xiàng bù fàng biān pào tā shuō tài chǎo duì ěr duo bù hǎo
items.en: Grandpa never sets off firecrackers; he says they are too noisy and bad for the ears.
items.why: 一向 describes a lifelong habit, so 不. 没 would claim that on one particular occasion he did not do it.

items.q: 奶奶今年打算___回老家过中秋节。
items.zh: 奶奶今年打算不回老家过中秋节。
items.py: nǎi nai jīn nián dǎ suàn bù huí lǎo jiā guò zhōng qiū jié
items.en: Grandma plans not to go back to her hometown for the Mid-Autumn Festival this year.
items.why: 打算 looks forward, so the plan not to go is 不. 没 cannot follow a verb of intending, because nothing has happened yet.

items.q: 今天的灯会人太多了，我们挤___进去，只好在外面看。
items.zh: 今天的灯会人太多了，我们挤不进去，只好在外面看。
items.py: jīn tiān de dēng huì rén tài duō le wǒ men jǐ bù jìn qù zhǐ hǎo zài wài miàn kàn
items.en: There were too many people at today's lantern fair, so we couldn't squeeze in and had to watch from outside.
items.why: 'Couldn't get in' is the potential form 挤不进去, with 不 inside the complement. 挤没进去 does not exist.

items.q: 元宵节那天我没去___看灯。
items.zh: 元宵节那天我没去看灯。
items.py: yuán xiāo jié nà tiān wǒ méi qù kàn dēng
items.en: I didn't go to see the lanterns on Lantern Festival day.
items.why: With 没 the verb stays bare: 没去看灯. 去了 would be the positive 'went'.

items.q: 我昨天___看足球赛，我去逛街了。
items.zh: 我昨天没看足球赛，我去逛街了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi kàn zú qiú sài wǒ qù guàng jiē le
items.en: I didn't watch the football match yesterday; I went shopping.
items.why: 昨天 makes it a past event that did not happen, so 没. 不看 would mean refusing or not going to watch.

items.q: 他说他明天___来参加比赛。
items.zh: 他说他明天不来参加比赛。
items.py: tā shuō tā míng tiān bù lái cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: He says he isn't coming to the match tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 means it has not happened yet, and a decision not to come is 不来. 没来 would report that he failed to show up.

items.q: 这里___可以游泳，水太深了。
items.zh: 这里不可以游泳，水太深了。
items.py: zhè lǐ bù kě yǐ yóu yǒng shuǐ tài shēn le
items.en: You can't swim here; the water is too deep.
items.why: 可以 is a modal verb and is negated with 不 (不可以 = not allowed). 没可以 does not exist.

items.zh: 因为下大雪，所以航班没起飞。
items.py: yīn wèi xià dà xuě suǒ yǐ háng bān méi qǐ fēi
items.en: Because of the heavy snow, the flight didn't take off.
items.why: 没 denies that the take-off happened. 没 stays directly before 起飞, and 不起飞 would suggest a general rule.

items.s: 我明天没坐火车去上海。
items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān méi zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
items.zh: 我明天不坐火车去上海。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān bù zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
items.en: I'm not taking the train to Shanghai tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 is the future, so a plan is negated with 不. 没 only denies something up to now.

items.s: 我没会开车，所以坐公共汽车去。
items.s_py: wǒ méi huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù
items.zh: 我不会开车，所以坐公共汽车去。
items.py: wǒ bú huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù
items.en: I can't drive, so I go by bus.
items.why: 会 is a modal verb and is negated with 不. 没会 does not exist.

items.q: 我___坐过飞机，所以有点儿紧张。
items.zh: 我没坐过飞机，所以有点儿紧张。
items.py: wǒ méi zuò guò fēi jī suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn r jǐn zhāng
items.en: I've never flown, so I'm a little nervous.
items.why: Verb + 过 is experience up to now, and its negative is 没: 没坐过. 不坐过 is not possible.

items.q: 邻居平时___养狗，他只养猫。
items.zh: 邻居平时不养狗，他只养猫。
items.py: lín jū píng shí bù yǎng gǒu tā zhǐ yǎng māo
items.en: My neighbour doesn't usually keep a dog; he only has a cat.
items.why: 平时 marks a standing habit, so 不 养. 没 养 would report one event that did not happen and clashes with 平时.

items.q: 我今天没做饭___，我们去外面吃吧。
items.zh: 我今天没做饭，我们去外面吃吧。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān méi zuò fàn wǒ men qù wài miàn chī ba
items.en: I didn't cook today, so let's eat out.
items.why: 没 replaces 了 when an action did not happen. 没做饭了 would be wrong for a one-time omission.

items.q: 我们___订到去北京的机票，所以只好改坐火车。
items.zh: 我们没订到去北京的机票，所以只好改坐火车。
items.py: wǒ men méi dìng dào qù běi jīng de jī piào suǒ yǐ zhǐ hǎo gǎi zuò huǒ chē
items.en: We didn't manage to book a flight to Beijing, so we had to go by train.
items.why: 订到 is a result that was not achieved, so 没订到. 不订到 is not a form, and 订不到 would say 'cannot get'.

items.q: 她没订机票___，打算坐火车去。
items.zh: 她没订机票，打算坐火车去。
items.py: tā méi dìng jī piào dǎ suan zuò huǒ chē qù
items.en: She didn't book a plane ticket; she plans to go by train.
items.why: 没订 already denies the booking, so no 了. A final 了 would be wrong here.

items.src_py: wǒ jiā yǒu diàn tī
items.zh: 我家没有电梯。
items.py: wǒ jiā méi yǒu diàn tī
items.en: My home has no lift.
items.why: 有 is negated only with 没: 没有电梯. 不有 does not exist.

items.zh: 我没找到我的行李。
items.py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào wǒ de xíng li
items.en: I didn't find my luggage.
items.why: 没 goes before the verb + result 找到. The object can be fronted as a topic, but 没 never moves behind 找到.

items.q: 我刚才进去的时候，他___在看地图，他在打电话。
items.zh: 我刚才进去的时候，他没在看地图，他在打电话。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái jìn qù de shí hou tā méi zài kàn dì tú tā zài dǎ diàn huà
items.en: When I went in just now, he wasn't looking at the map; he was on the phone.
items.why: 刚才 puts the moment in the past, and 没在 + verb denies an action that was not in progress then: 没在看. 不在看 is the less safe form for a past moment.

items.s: 他没在家，他出差了。
items.zh: 他没在家，他出差了。
items.py: tā méi zài jiā tā chū chāi le
items.en: He isn't at home; he's away on a business trip.
items.why: Correct: 没在 + place is accepted, especially when reporting a situation; 不在家 would also be fine.

items.q: 他___是我们的邻居，他住在别的楼。
items.zh: 他不是我们的邻居，他住在别的楼。
items.py: tā bú shì wǒ men de lín jū tā zhù zài bié de lóu
items.en: He isn't our neighbour; he lives in another building.
items.why: 是 is only negated with 不: 不是. 没是 and 没有是 do not exist.

items.q: 虽然看了好几套房子，但是我一套也没租___。
items.zh: 虽然看了好几套房子，但是我一套也没租。
items.py: suī rán kàn le hǎo jǐ tào fáng zi dàn shì wǒ yī tào yě méi zū
items.en: Although I looked at several flats, I didn't rent a single one.
items.why: The first clause has 了 for a completed viewing, but the negated 没租 takes none. 一套也没租 is a plain negative, not 'no longer'.

items.s: 我在这个小区住了十年，可是我不去过邻居家。
items.s_py: wǒ zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù le shí nián kě shì wǒ bù qù guò lín jū jiā
items.zh: 我在这个小区住了十年，可是我没去过邻居家。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù le shí nián kě shì wǒ méi qù guò lín jū jiā
items.en: I've lived in this complex for ten years, but I've never been to my neighbour's home.
items.why: Verb + 过 is experience, and its negative is always 没: 没去过. 不 cannot combine with 过.

items.s: 他没是我们楼的邻居。
items.s_py: tā méi shì wǒ men lóu de lín jū
items.zh: 他不是我们楼的邻居。
items.py: tā bú shì wǒ men lóu de lín jū
items.en: He isn't a neighbour in our building.
items.why: 是 is only ever negated with 不: 不是. 没是 is not a form.

items.zh: 这不是我的房间。
items.py: zhè bú shì wǒ de fáng jiān
items.en: This isn't my room.
items.why: 是 is negated only with 不: 不是. 没是 does not exist.

items.s: 昨天这间屋子不冷，我们没开暖气。
items.zh: 昨天这间屋子不冷，我们没开暖气。
items.py: zuó tiān zhè jiān wū zi bù lěng wǒ men méi kāi nuǎn qì
items.en: This room wasn't cold yesterday, so we didn't turn on the heating.
items.why: Correct: the adjective 冷 takes 不 even about yesterday, while 没开 negates the event of switching the heating on.

items.zh: 昨天我没去火车站。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ méi qù huǒ chē zhàn
items.en: I didn't go to the train station yesterday.
items.why: 没 comes right before the verb 去; the time word may precede or follow the subject, but 没 cannot move in front of the time word.

items.s: 我没能赶上那班火车，真可惜。
items.zh: 我没能赶上那班火车，真可惜。
items.py: wǒ méi néng gǎn shàng nà bān huǒ chē zhēn kě xī
items.en: I didn't manage to catch that train, what a pity.
items.why: Correct: 没能 + verb means 'did not manage to'. It is not 没 + modal, but a normal fixed form.

items.src_py: tā píng shí zuò dì tiě shàng bān
items.zh: 他平时不坐地铁上班。
items.py: tā píng shí bù zuò dì tiě shàng bān
items.en: He doesn't usually take the metro to work.
items.why: 平时 describes a habit, so 不 goes before 坐地铁. 没 would only deny a single event.

items.src_py: tā zuó tiān bān zǒu le
items.zh: 他昨天没搬走。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi bān zǒu
items.en: He didn't move out yesterday.
items.why: To negate a completed action, put 没 before the verb and drop 了: 没搬走. Keeping 了 would be wrong.

items.q: 楼下的老人身体不太好，所以晚上一般___出门，都在家看电视。
items.zh: 楼下的老人身体不太好，所以晚上一般不出门，都在家看电视。
items.py: lóu xia de lǎo rén shēn tǐ bù tài hǎo suǒ yǐ wǎn shang yì bān bù chū mén dōu zài jiā kàn diàn shì
items.en: The old man downstairs isn't very well, so he usually doesn't go out in the evening and watches TV at home.
items.why: 一般 means 'as a rule', a habit, so 不 出门. 没 出门 would be one evening on which he did not go out.

items.zh: 邻居昨天一整天都没出门。
items.py: lín jū zuó tiān yī zhěng tiān dōu méi chū mén
items.en: The neighbour didn't go out all day yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes before the verb 出门, after 都, and there is no 了. The time phrase may stand before or after 邻居.

items.q: 我小时候___爱坐长途汽车，一坐就晕车。
items.zh: 我小时候不爱坐长途汽车，一坐就晕车。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù ài zuò cháng tú qì chē yī zuò jiù yùn chē
items.en: When I was little I didn't like long coach rides; I got carsick as soon as I got on.
items.why: 爱 is a liking, a state, so it takes 不 even for childhood. 没爱 is not a form.

items.zh: 我不知道那家旅馆在哪儿。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào nà jiā lǚ guǎn zài nǎ r
items.en: I don't know where that hotel is.
items.why: 知道 is a state verb and takes 不, placed right before it. Fronting 那家旅馆 as a topic is also possible, but 不 still sits before 知道.

items.q: 行李你自己拿不动的话就放着，___勉强，我来帮你。
items.zh: 行李你自己拿不动的话就放着，别勉强，我来帮你。
items.py: xíng li nǐ zì jǐ ná bù dòng de huà jiù fàng zhe bié miǎn qiǎng wǒ lái bāng nǐ
items.en: If you can't carry the luggage yourself, leave it; don't force it, I'll help.
items.why: 别勉强 is a gentle order: 'don't push yourself'. 不勉强 and 没勉强 would state facts instead.

items.q: 下雨路滑，开车的时候___开得太快。
items.zh: 下雨路滑，开车的时候别开得太快。
items.py: xià yǔ lù huá kāi chē de shí hou bié kāi de tài kuài
items.en: The road is slippery in the rain, so don't drive too fast.
items.why: This is a warning, so 别. 不开得太快 would state that you do not drive fast, and 没 refers to the past.

items.q: 我昨天___去机场。
items.zh: 我昨天没去机场。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù jī chǎng
items.en: I didn't go to the airport yesterday.
items.why: 昨天 plus an action that did not take place needs 没. 不去 would mean 'am not going' or 'refuse to go'.

items.s: 我们到了机场才发现，同事没带了护照。
items.s_py: wǒ men dào le jī chǎng cái fā xiàn tóng shì méi dài le hù zhào
items.zh: 我们到了机场才发现，同事没带护照。
items.py: wǒ men dào le jī chǎng cái fā xiàn tóng shì méi dài hù zhào
items.en: When we got to the airport we found that my colleague hadn't brought his passport.
items.why: 没带 denies the bringing, so there is no 了. 没...了 would be wrong for a plain event.

items.q: 请___在房间里抽烟。
items.zh: 请不要在房间里抽烟。
items.py: qǐng bú yào zài fáng jiān lǐ chōu yān
items.en: Please don't smoke in the room.
items.why: A prohibition is 不要 (or 别). 不用 means 'no need to' and would not forbid anything.

items.q: 我昨天加班到很晚，___赶上末班地铁，只好打车回家。
items.zh: 我昨天加班到很晚，没能赶上末班地铁，只好打车回家。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān jiā bān dào hěn wǎn méi néng gǎn shàng mò bān dì tiě zhǐ hǎo dǎ chē huí jiā
items.en: I worked late yesterday and didn't manage to catch the last metro, so I had to take a taxi home.
items.why: 没能 + verb means 'did not manage to' about a past attempt. 不能 means 'is not allowed or able' in general, and 不会 predicts the future.

items.q: 行李太多了，这辆小汽车放___下，我们得再叫一辆车。
items.zh: 行李太多了，这辆小汽车放不下，我们得再叫一辆车。
items.py: xíng li tài duō le zhè liàng xiǎo qì chē fàng bù xià wǒ men děi zài jiào yī liàng chē
items.en: There's too much luggage; it won't fit in this car, so we need to call another one.
items.why: 'Will not fit' is a potential complement, verb + 不 + 下: 放不下. 没 cannot go between verb and result.

items.q: 机票我已经订好了，你___再订了。
items.zh: 机票我已经订好了，你不用再订了。
items.py: jī piào wǒ yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le nǐ bù yòng zài dìng le
items.en: I've already booked the ticket; you don't need to book one again.
items.why: 不用 means 'no need to' and fits a situation where it is already done. 没 and bare 不 do not express that.

items.s: 我们好久没见面了，你搬到哪儿住了？
items.zh: 我们好久没见面了，你搬到哪儿住了？
items.py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn miàn le nǐ bān dào nǎ r zhù le
items.en: We haven't seen each other for ages. Where have you moved to?
items.why: This is correct: 好久没...了 is a fixed pattern for a long time without something, and 了 marks the new situation, not a completed action.

items.q: 太累了，我现在___想出门，你们去吧。
items.zh: 太累了，我现在不想出门，你们去吧。
items.py: tài lèi le wǒ xiàn zài bù xiǎng chū mén nǐ men qù ba
items.en: I'm too tired and don't feel like going out now; you go ahead.
items.why: 想 here is a wish ('feel like'), a modal, so 不想. 没想 would not express a present lack of desire.

items.s: 他说得太快，我不听懂。
items.s_py: tā shuō de tài kuài wǒ bù tīng dǒng
items.zh: 他说得太快，我听不懂。
items.py: tā shuō de tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: He speaks too fast; I can't understand.
items.why: 'Can't understand' is the potential form 听不懂, with 不 between verb and result. 不听懂 is not possible.

items.q: 我___会开车，所以每天坐公共汽车。
items.zh: 我不会开车，所以每天坐公共汽车。
items.py: wǒ bú huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ měi tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē
items.en: I can't drive, so I take the bus every day.
items.why: 会 (know how to) is a modal and is negated with 不: 不会. 没会 does not exist.

items.q: 对不起，我___知道这条路怎么走，你问问别人吧。
items.zh: 对不起，我不知道这条路怎么走，你问问别人吧。
items.py: duì bù qǐ wǒ bù zhī dào zhè tiáo lù zěn me zǒu nǐ wèn wèn bié rén ba
items.en: Sorry, I don't know how to get there; ask someone else.
items.why: 知道 is a state of knowledge, so 不知道. 没知道 is not used for 'don't know'.

items.s: 屋里有人在睡觉，你们不说话！
items.s_py: wū lǐ yǒu rén zài shuì jiào nǐ men bù shuō huà
items.zh: 屋里有人在睡觉，你们别说话！
items.py: wū lǐ yǒu rén zài shuì jiào nǐ men bié shuō huà
items.en: Someone is sleeping in there; don't talk!
items.why: An order needs 别 or 不要. 你们不说话 only states that you are not talking.

items.q: 他说他明天___来，因为他要去北京。
items.zh: 他说他明天不来，因为他要去北京。
items.py: tā shuō tā míng tiān bù lái yīn wèi tā yào qù běi jīng
items.en: He says he isn't coming tomorrow because he's going to Beijing.
items.why: 明天 and 他说 give a plan, so 不来. 没来 means 'did not come' and cannot refer to tomorrow.

items.q: 晚上十点以后，请___在楼道里大声说话。
items.zh: 晚上十点以后，请别在楼道里大声说话。
items.py: wǎn shang shí diǎn yǐ hòu qǐng bié zài lóu dào lǐ dà shēng shuō huà
items.en: Please don't talk loudly in the stairwell after ten at night.
items.why: An instruction not to do something needs 别 or 不要. Bare 不 and 没 only state or deny facts.

items.s: 我以前不坐地铁，现在每天都坐。
items.zh: 我以前不坐地铁，现在每天都坐。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián bù zuò dì tiě xiàn zài měi tiān dōu zuò
items.en: I didn't use to take the metro; now I take it every day.
items.why: Correct: a past habit is still negated with 不, even though 以前 points to the past.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le guǎng bō
items.task: Make it negative (you did not understand it).
items.zh: 我没听懂广播。
items.py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng guǎng bō
items.en: I didn't understand the announcement.
items.why: A result not reached is 没 + verb + result, and 了 is dropped. 听不懂 would instead say 'cannot understand'.

items.q: 我在这个小区住了两年，从来___见过房东。
items.zh: 我在这个小区住了两年，从来没见过房东。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù le liǎng nián cóng lái méi jiàn guò fáng dōng
items.en: I've lived in this complex for two years and have never met the landlord.
items.why: 从来没 + verb + 过 is 'never have done'. 从来不见过 is not a form, because 过 needs 没.

items.q: 这套房子的位置很好，可是价格___便宜，所以我还在考虑。
items.zh: 这套房子的位置很好，可是价格不便宜，所以我还在考虑。
items.py: zhè tào fáng zi de wèi zhì hěn hǎo kě shì jià gé bù biàn yi suǒ yǐ wǒ hái zài kǎo lǜ
items.en: The flat is well located, but the price isn't cheap, so I'm still thinking about it.
items.why: 便宜 is an adjective and describes a quality, so 不便宜. 没便宜 would suggest a price that has not dropped.

items.q: 这个小区里___有超市，买东西很不方便。
items.zh: 这个小区里没有超市，买东西很不方便。
items.py: zhè ge xiǎo qū lǐ méi yǒu chāo shì mǎi dōng xi hěn bù fāng biàn
items.en: There's no supermarket in this complex, so shopping is inconvenient.
items.why: 'There is no...' is 没有. 有 never combines with 不.

items.q: 我已经跟房东说了，下个月我___续租。
items.zh: 我已经跟房东说了，下个月我不续租。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng gēn fáng dōng shuō le xià ge yuè wǒ bù xù zū
items.en: I've already told the landlord that I won't renew the lease next month.
items.why: 下个月 is the future and it is my decision, so 不. 没 cannot look forward to next month.

items.q: 路上堵车，我们___赶上那班火车。
items.zh: 路上堵车，我们没赶上那班火车。
items.py: lù shang dǔ chē wǒ men méi gǎn shàng nà bān huǒ chē
items.en: There was a traffic jam, so we didn't catch that train.
items.why: The result 赶上 was not achieved on one occasion, so 没赶上. 不赶上 cannot be used before the verb.

items.q: 我们等了他半个小时，结果他___来，我们只好先走了。
items.zh: 我们等了他半个小时，结果他没来，我们只好先走了。
items.py: wǒ men děng le tā bàn ge xiǎo shí jié guǒ tā méi lái wǒ men zhǐ hǎo xiān zǒu le
items.en: We waited half an hour for him, but he didn't turn up, so we had to leave first.
items.why: 结果 introduces what actually happened, so 没来. 不来 would give his intention or refusal and does not fit a reported outcome.

items.q: 房东说下个月这栋楼暂时___有电梯，因为要维修。
items.zh: 房东说下个月这栋楼暂时没有电梯，因为要维修。
items.py: fáng dōng shuō xià ge yuè zhè dòng lóu zàn shí méi yǒu diàn tī yīn wèi yào wéi xiū
items.en: The landlord says the building will have no lift for a while next month because of repairs.
items.why: Even for the future, 有 stays with 没: 没有电梯. 不有 is never possible, so 下个月 does not change it.

items.q: 邻居___愿意把花园的钥匙借给我们，我们只好找别人。
items.zh: 邻居不愿意把花园的钥匙借给我们，我们只好找别人。
items.py: lín jū bù yuàn yì bǎ huā yuán de yào shi jiè gěi wǒ men wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zhǎo bié rén
items.en: The neighbour wasn't willing to lend us the garden key, so we had to ask someone else.
items.why: 愿意 expresses willingness, so it takes 不 even in the past. 没愿意 is not a form.

items.q: 我明天___去火车站。
items.zh: 我明天不去火车站。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān bù qù huǒ chē zhàn
items.en: I'm not going to the train station tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 is the future, so this is a plan, and a plan is negated with 不. 没 only denies something that has not happened so far.

items.s: 天还没黑，我们再往前走一会儿吧。
items.zh: 天还没黑，我们再往前走一会儿吧。
items.py: tiān hái méi hēi wǒ men zài wǎng qián zǒu yī huì r ba
items.en: It isn't dark yet; let's walk on a little further.
items.why: Correct: 还没 + adjective says that a change has not yet happened, so 没 is right here.

items.q: 我找了半天，也___找到我的行李箱。
items.zh: 我找了半天，也没找到我的行李箱。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào wǒ de xíng li xiāng
items.en: I searched for ages but still didn't find my suitcase.
items.why: 'Didn't find it' is 没 + verb + result. 不找到 is not a form; 找不到 would be the 'can't' version.

items.s: 邻居昨天没回来了。
items.s_py: lín jū zuó tiān méi huí lái le
items.zh: 邻居昨天没回来。
items.py: lín jū zuó tiān méi huí lái
items.en: The neighbour didn't come back yesterday.
items.why: 没 says the action did not happen, so the completion 了 has to go.

items.q: 窗户外面太吵了，我晚上睡___着。
items.zh: 窗户外面太吵了，我晚上睡不着。
items.py: chuāng hu wài miàn tài chǎo le wǒ wǎn shang shuì bù zháo
items.en: It's so noisy outside the window that I can't fall asleep at night.
items.why: 'Can't fall asleep' is the potential form 睡不着, with 不 between verb and result. 睡没着 does not exist.

items.q: 老师说得太快，我___听懂。
items.zh: 老师说得太快，我没听懂。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: The teacher spoke too fast and I didn't understand.
items.why: The cue says 'didn't understand', a result not reached, so 没 goes before the verb: 没听懂. 不听懂 is not a form.

items.q: 我们打算下个月搬家，所以这份合同到期以后___再续了。
items.zh: 我们打算下个月搬家，所以这份合同到期以后不再续了。
items.py: wǒ men dǎ suan xià ge yuè bān jiā suǒ yǐ zhè fèn hé tóng dào qī yǐ hòu bù zài xù le
items.en: We plan to move next month, so we won't renew this contract after it expires.
items.why: 到期以后 is still in the future and 打算 gives a plan, so 不再续了 ('will not renew again'). 没 cannot look forward.

items.q: 你___应该把行李放在走廊里，会挡住别人。
items.zh: 你不应该把行李放在走廊里，会挡住别人。
items.py: nǐ bù yīng gāi bǎ xíng li fàng zài zǒu láng lǐ huì dǎng zhù bié rén
items.en: You shouldn't leave your luggage in the corridor; it blocks other people.
items.why: 应该 is a modal, so 不应该. 没应该 is not a form.

items.s: 你不用送我到车站，我自己能去。
items.zh: 你不用送我到车站，我自己能去。
items.py: nǐ bù yòng sòng wǒ dào chē zhàn wǒ zì jǐ néng qù
items.en: You don't need to take me to the station; I can get there myself.
items.why: Correct: 不用 means 'no need to', which fits an offer you politely turn down.

items.q: 这里___能停车，请把车开走。
items.zh: 这里不能停车，请把车开走。
items.py: zhè lǐ bù néng tíng chē qǐng bǎ chē kāi zǒu
items.en: You can't park here; please move your car.
items.why: 能 is a modal, so 不能. 没能 means 'did not manage to' and does not fit a rule about the place.

items.q: 明天我___有时间，我们改天再聊吧。
items.zh: 明天我没有时间，我们改天再聊吧。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān wǒ men gǎi tiān zài liáo ba
items.en: I don't have time tomorrow; let's talk another day.
items.why: Even about tomorrow, 有 is negated with 没. 不有 is not a form in any tense.

items.q: 房东已经把钥匙给我了，所以你们___去办手续了。
items.zh: 房东已经把钥匙给我了，所以你们不用去办手续了。
items.py: fáng dōng yǐ jīng bǎ yào shi gěi wǒ le suǒ yǐ nǐ men bù yòng qù bàn shǒu xù le
items.en: The landlord has already given me the key, so you don't need to go and do the paperwork.
items.why: 不用 says 'no need to', which fits a task that has been taken care of. 没 and 没能 would describe something that did not happen, which does not fit.

items.q: 我___吃肉，我是素食者。
items.zh: 我不吃肉，我是素食者。
items.py: wǒ bù chī ròu wǒ shì sù shí zhě
items.en: I don't eat meat; I'm a vegetarian.
items.why: 素食者 makes this a habit, a rule, so 不吃. 没吃 would only say that you did not eat it once.

items.q: 邻居说他昨天一晚上都没睡___，因为楼上太吵了。
items.zh: 邻居说他昨天一晚上都没睡，因为楼上太吵了。
items.py: lín jū shuō tā zuó tiān yī wǎn shang dōu méi shuì yīn wèi lóu shang tài chǎo le
items.en: The neighbour says he didn't sleep all night yesterday because the upstairs was too noisy.
items.why: 没睡 negates the night's sleep, with no 了. 过 would turn it into an experience ('have never slept').

items.s: 明天我没有课，可以陪你去看房子。
items.zh: 明天我没有课，可以陪你去看房子。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ méi yǒu kè kě yǐ péi nǐ qù kàn fáng zi
items.en: I don't have class tomorrow, so I can go with you to look at flats.
items.why: Correct: even with 明天, 有 is negated with 没, never 不.

items.q: 昨天我请邻居来吃饭，我们等到很晚，他也___来。
items.zh: 昨天我请邻居来吃饭，我们等到很晚，他也没来。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ qǐng lín jū lái chī fàn wǒ men děng dào hěn wǎn tā yě méi lái
items.en: I invited the neighbour to dinner yesterday; we waited until late and he still didn't come.
items.why: 等到很晚 reports what actually happened, so 没来. 不来 would give a refusal rather than an observed fact.

items.s: 你家有不有电视？
items.s_py: nǐ jiā yǒu bù yǒu diàn shì
items.zh: 你家有没有电视？
items.py: nǐ jiā yǒu méi yǒu diàn shì
items.en: Do you have a TV at home?
items.why: The A-not-A form of 有 is 有没有, because 有's negative is 没. 有不有 is not possible.

items.q: 邻居昨天没搬走___，下周才搬。
items.zh: 邻居昨天没搬走，下周才搬。
items.py: lín jū zuó tiān méi bān zǒu xià zhōu cái bān
items.en: The neighbour didn't move out yesterday; he's moving next week.
items.why: Negating a completed action replaces 了 with 没. 了 cannot stay after the verb.

items.q: 火车还___到，我们再等一会儿。
items.zh: 火车还没到，我们再等一会儿。
items.py: huǒ chē hái méi dào wǒ men zài děng yī huì r
items.en: The train hasn't arrived yet; let's wait a bit longer.
items.why: 还没 + verb means 'not yet': the arrival has not happened so far. 还不到 is not used for an expected arrival.

items.q: 上个月我们___去旅行，因为我生病了。
items.zh: 上个月我们没去旅行，因为我生病了。
items.py: shàng ge yuè wǒ men méi qù lǚ xíng yīn wèi wǒ shēng bìng le
items.en: We didn't go on a trip last month because I was ill.
items.why: 上个月 is a finished period and the trip did not take place, so 没. 不去 would be a refusal or plan.

items.q: 旅馆的房间里___有空调，晚上特别热。
items.zh: 旅馆的房间里没有空调，晚上特别热。
items.py: lǚ guǎn de fáng jiān lǐ méi yǒu kòng diào wǎn shang tè bié rè
items.en: There's no air conditioning in the hotel room, so it's very hot at night.
items.why: Existence 有 is negated only with 没: 没有空调. 不有 does not exist.

items.src_py: nǐ zài zhè lǐ tíng chē
items.task: Tell the person not to do it.
items.zh: 你别在这里停车。
items.py: nǐ bié zài zhè lǐ tíng chē
items.en: Don't park here.
items.why: To forbid an action, put 别 (or 不要) before the verb phrase. A bare 不 would only state that you are not parking.

items.q: 房租太高了，我决定___租这套房子。
items.zh: 房租太高了，我决定不租这套房子。
items.py: fáng zū tài gāo le wǒ jué dìng bù zū zhè tào fáng zi
items.en: The rent is too high, so I've decided not to rent this flat.
items.why: 决定 points to a choice about the future, which is 不. 没租 would only say that the renting did not happen.

items.q: 我们到了酒店才发现，朋友___订房间，只好重新找一家。
items.zh: 我们到了酒店才发现，朋友没订房间，只好重新找一家。
items.py: wǒ men dào le jiǔ diàn cái fā xiàn péng you méi dìng fáng jiān zhǐ hǎo chóng xīn zhǎo yī jiā
items.en: When we reached the hotel we found that my friend hadn't booked a room, so we had to look for another one.
items.why: 才发现 reports an earlier fact: the booking did not happen. 不订 would describe a choice not to book.

items.q: 你们小区___停车位？
items.zh: 你们小区有没有停车位？
items.py: nǐ men xiǎo qū yǒu méi yǒu tíng chē wèi
items.en: Does your complex have parking spaces?
items.why: The question form of 有 is 有没有. Because 有's negative is 没, 有不有 and 不有 are both impossible.

items.s: 这么大的行李箱，出租车的后备厢肯定放不下。
items.zh: 这么大的行李箱，出租车的后备厢肯定放不下。
items.py: zhè me dà de xíng li xiāng chū zū chē de hòu bèi xiāng kěn dìng fàng bù xià
items.en: Such a big suitcase will definitely not fit in a taxi's boot.
items.why: Correct: 放不下 is the potential form 'cannot fit'. 没放下 would instead mean 'did not put down'.

items.q: 我还___吃早饭呢，饿死了。
items.zh: 我还没吃早饭呢，饿死了。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī zǎo fàn ne è sǐ le
items.en: I haven't had breakfast yet; I'm starving.
items.why: 还...呢 is 'not yet', and not yet is always 没. 不吃 would say you refuse to eat or never do.

items.q: 这条街上___有银行，取钱要坐车去。
items.zh: 这条街上没有银行，取钱要坐车去。
items.py: zhè tiáo jiē shàng méi yǒu yín háng qǔ qián yào zuò chē qù
items.en: There's no bank on this street; you have to take a bus to withdraw money.
items.why: 'There is no bank' is 没有银行. 不有 is never possible.

items.q: 司机说他今天___开车去机场，让我们坐地铁去。
items.zh: 司机说他今天不开车去机场，让我们坐地铁去。
items.py: sī jī shuō tā jīn tiān bù kāi chē qù jī chǎng ràng wǒ men zuò dì tiě qù
items.en: The driver says he's not driving to the airport today and told us to take the metro.
items.why: 今天 with 让我们 gives his decision, so 不. 没开 would only report that he did not drive.

items.zh: 他从来不坐公共汽车。
items.py: tā cóng lái bù zuò gōng gòng qì chē
items.en: He never takes the bus.
items.why: 从来不 + verb states a standing habit: 不 sits directly before 坐, after 从来. 没 would need 过 and be about experience (从来没坐过).

items.zh: 这里不能拍照。
items.py: zhè lǐ bù néng pāi zhào
items.en: You can't take photos here.
items.why: 不 stays before the modal 能 and not before the main verb: 不能拍照.

items.q: 他搬进来快一个月了，我还___见过他的家人。
items.zh: 他搬进来快一个月了，我还没见过他的家人。
items.py: tā bān jìn lái kuài yí ge yuè le wǒ hái méi jiàn guò tā de jiā rén
items.en: He's been here almost a month and I still haven't met his family.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 过 says that up to now it has not happened, so 没. 不 cannot combine with 过.

items.q: 我从来___喝酒，因为我对酒过敏。
items.zh: 我从来不喝酒，因为我对酒过敏。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē jiǔ yīn wèi wǒ duì jiǔ guò mǐn
items.en: I never drink, because I'm allergic to alcohol.
items.why: 从来不 + verb states a standing habit. 从来没 would need 过 (从来没喝过酒) and talks about experience rather than a habit with a reason.

items.q: 我昨天没去上班___。
items.zh: 我昨天没去上班。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù shàng bān
items.en: I didn't go to work yesterday.
items.why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so there is no completion to mark and 了 must go.

items.zh: 孩子们别在走廊里跑步。
items.py: hái zi men bié zài zǒu láng lǐ pǎo bù
items.en: Children, don't run in the corridor.
items.why: 别 comes before the verb phrase to give the order. A place phrase 在走廊里 may precede 孩子们, but 别 stays in front of 跑步.

items.q: 地铁站太大了，我找___到出口。
items.zh: 地铁站太大了，我找不到出口。
items.py: dì tiě zhàn tài dà le wǒ zhǎo bú dào chū kǒu
items.en: The metro station is so big that I can't find the exit.
items.why: 'Can't find' is the potential form: verb + 不 + result, 找不到. 找没到 does not exist.

items.q: 我以前坐地铁上班，以后___坐了，我打算自己开车。
items.zh: 我以前坐地铁上班，以后不坐了，我打算自己开车。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zuò dì tiě shàng bān yǐ hòu bù zuò le wǒ dǎ suan zì jǐ kāi chē
items.en: I used to take the metro to work, but from now on I won't; I plan to drive myself.
items.why: 以后 looks forward, and a decision about the future is negated with 不: 不...了 'no longer'. 没 cannot look forward.

items.q: 昨天___冷，我没穿外套。
items.zh: 昨天不冷，我没穿外套。
items.py: zuó tiān bù lěng wǒ méi chuān wài tào
items.en: It wasn't cold yesterday, so I didn't wear a coat.
items.why: 冷 is an adjective, a quality, so it is negated with 不 even about yesterday. 没 would suggest the event 'it did not turn cold'.

items.q: 我以前___喜欢住高层，现在觉得很方便。
items.zh: 我以前不喜欢住高层，现在觉得很方便。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián bù xǐ huan zhù gāo céng xiàn zài jué de hěn fāng biàn
items.en: I didn't used to like living on a high floor; now I find it convenient.
items.why: 喜欢 is a feeling, a state, so it takes 不 even with 以前. 没喜欢 is not a form.

items.q: 他的签证还没办下来，所以这次旅行他___可以和我们一起出国。
items.zh: 他的签证还没办下来，所以这次旅行他不可以和我们一起出国。
items.py: tā de qiān zhèng hái méi bàn xià lái suǒ yǐ zhè cì lǚ xíng tā bù kě yǐ hé wǒ men yì qǐ chū guó
items.en: His visa hasn't come through yet, so he can't go abroad with us on this trip.
items.why: 可以 (be allowed to) is a modal and takes 不: 不可以. 没可以 does not exist, even though 还没 appears earlier in the sentence.

items.q: 孩子睡着了，你们___吵了。
items.zh: 孩子睡着了，你们别吵了。
items.py: hái zi shuì zháo le nǐ men bié chǎo le
items.en: The child has fallen asleep; stop making noise.
items.why: 别...了 tells someone to stop an action. 不 and 没 are not commands.

items.q: 我们约好八点在车站见面，可是小王___来，也没打电话。
items.zh: 我们约好八点在车站见面，可是小王没来，也没打电话。
items.py: wǒ men yuē hǎo bā diǎn zài chē zhàn jiàn miàn kě shì xiǎo wáng méi lái yě méi dǎ diàn huà
items.en: We agreed to meet at the station at eight, but Xiao Wang didn't come and didn't phone either.
items.why: 可是 reports what happened against the plan, and 也没打电话 uses 没 as well, so 没来. 不来 would be a refusal.

items.s: 我昨天不想坐地铁，就打车去了。
items.zh: 我昨天不想坐地铁，就打车去了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān bù xiǎng zuò dì tiě jiù dǎ chē qù le
items.en: I didn't feel like taking the metro yesterday, so I took a taxi.
items.why: Correct: 想 is a wish and takes 不 even for the past; 没想 would mean something else.

items.q: 我听说那个小区的物业很好，可是我___知道具体的情况，不敢乱说。
items.zh: 我听说那个小区的物业很好，可是我不知道具体的情况，不敢乱说。
items.py: wǒ tīng shuō nà ge xiǎo qū de wù yè hěn hǎo kě shì wǒ bù zhī dào jù tǐ de qíng kuàng bù gǎn luàn shuō
items.en: I've heard the management of that complex is good, but I don't know the details, so I won't comment.
items.why: 知道 is a state verb: 不知道 gives the present state of knowing. 没知道 is not natural for this meaning.

items.q: 他今天没来___，我们先吃吧。
items.zh: 他今天没来，我们先吃吧。
items.py: tā jīn tiān méi lái wǒ men xiān chī ba
items.en: He didn't come today, so let's eat first.
items.why: With 没, the action is not completed, so 了 is dropped: 没来. 没来了 is not a sentence for a plain past event.

items.q: 旅馆附近___有饭馆，晚饭只能叫外卖。
items.zh: 旅馆附近没有饭馆，晚饭只能叫外卖。
items.py: lǚ guǎn fù jìn méi yǒu fàn guǎn wǎn fàn zhǐ néng jiào wài mài
items.en: There's no restaurant near the hotel, so dinner has to be takeaway.
items.why: 有 is only negated with 没: 没有. 不有 does not exist.
